A time-left line along the bottom (3 px tall) shrinks linearly from 194 px to 0 over 1.4–3.2 s.
Exit: slides 240 px out to the right over 3.2–3.55 s with easeInOutCubic.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。光标在 1.0 秒点击蓝色“保存”按钮（110×36，左下角），随后从左下方离开。
轻提示：#26282c，214×52，圆角半径 10，距右侧 18 px、距底部 16 px；1.05–1.4 秒以 easeOutCubic 从右侧滑入 240 px。
内部：蓝色圆中的白色对勾，以及白色 15 px“已保存”文字。
底部剩余时间线（高 3 px）在 1.4–3.2 秒内线性从 194 px 缩短至 0。
退场：3.2–3.55 秒以 easeInOutCubic 向右滑出 240 px。

use.en: Use it to confirm a result such as a save or send without interrupting the user.
use.zh-Hans: 适合在不中断用户操作的情况下，确认保存或发送等结果。

meaning.en: Click a label to switch which panel is shown
meaning.zh-Hans: 点击标签切换内容面板

ask.en: Put three tabs at the top of the pricing page. On click, slide the underline over 0.25 s and cross-fade the content in 0.2 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 价格页顶部放三个标签页，下划线用 0.25 s 滑动，内容用 0.2 s 叠化。

summary.en: Clicking the tabs "Overview, Pricing, Reviews" in turn slides a blue underline across and swaps the content below.
summary.zh-Hans: 依次点击“概览、价格、评价”标签页，蓝色下划线横向滑动，下方内容随之切换。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Three tabs at x 24, 114, 204, widths 70, 70, 100; a 2 px divider at y 50 and a 4 px blue underline.
The cursor clicks the second tab at 1.0 s, the third at 2.2 s and the first at 3.4 s.
Underline: position and width move to the new tab over 0.25 s from each click with easeInOutCubic (from the third back to the first it passes through the middle).
Labels: selected is blue and bold, others grey; the switch happens at 1.1, 2.3 and 3.5 s.
Content: the old panel fades out linearly in 0.2 s; 0.1 s later the new one fades in over 0.2 s while rising 8 px.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。三个标签页位于 x = 24、114、204，宽度分别为 70、70、100；y = 50 处有 2 px 分隔线，另有 4 px 蓝色下划线。
光标在 1.0 秒点击第二项，2.2 秒点击第三项，3.4 秒点击第一项。
下划线：每次点击后，在 0.25 秒内以 easeInOutCubic 将位置和宽度移动至新标签（从第三项回到第一项时会经过中间项）。
标签文字：选中项为蓝色粗体，其余为灰色；状态在 1.1、2.3 和 3.5 秒切换。
内容：旧面板在 0.2 秒内线性淡出；0.1 秒后，新面板用 0.2 秒淡入并上升 8 px。

use.en: Use it to show several related views in the same space and let people switch between them.
use.zh-Hans: 适合在同一空间展示多个相关视图，供用户切换。

meaning.en: Slides that move sideways to show one item at a time
meaning.zh-Hans: 横向滑动切换展示项

ask.en: Turn the top images into a carousel: the right arrow moves one slide in 0.4 s, with position dots below.
ask.zh-Hans: 把顶部图片做成轮播图，右箭头每次用 0.4 s 切一张，下方显示位置圆点。

summary.en: Each click on the right arrow slides a row of three different images one step to the left, and the dot below moves.
summary.zh-Hans: 每次点击右箭头，三张不同图片组成的横排便向左移动一格，下方指示点随之变化。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Slides 330×138, radius 8, centred with an 18 px gap; the neighbours peek in at the edges.
White round buttons (radius 18, shadow blur 10) with chevrons at left and right; three dots below (current one blue 16×8, others 8×8).
The cursor clicks the right arrow (514, 88) at 1.0, 2.1 and 3.2 s.
Each click moves the row 348 px left (one slide plus gap) over 0.4 s with easeInOutCubic.
The three pictures (landscape, three circles, bar chart) repeat, so after three moves the first is back.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。幻灯片尺寸 330×138，圆角半径 8，居中排列，间隔 18 px；相邻图片在边缘露出一部分。
左右各有带折角箭头的白色圆按钮（半径 18，阴影模糊 10）；下方三个指示点（当前项为蓝色 16×8，其余为 8×8）。
每次点击后，整排在 0.4 秒内以 easeInOutCubic 向左移动 348 px（一张图片加间隔）。
三幅图片（风景、三个圆、柱状图）循环排列，因此移动三次后回到第一幅。

use.en: Use it to show several images or featured items in limited space, one at a time.
use.zh-Hans: 适合在有限空间中逐张展示多幅图片或精选项目。

meaning.en: Flip a setting on or off
meaning.zh-Hans: 切换设置的开启与关闭状态

ask.en: Put a toggle switch on each notification setting: the knob slides in 0.2 s and the track turns blue when on.
ask.zh-Hans: 通知设置使用开关，滑块用 0.2 s 移动，开启时轨道变蓝。

summary.en: The switches on the first two of three setting rows are turned on in turn, then off again.
summary.zh-Hans: 三行设置中，前两行的开关依次打开，再依次关闭。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Three setting rows 60 px apart with dividers. At x 450 a 64×34 track (radius 17) and a white knob (radius 13, shadow).
Clicks: row 1 on at 1.0 s, row 2 on at 1.8 s, row 1 off at 3.0 s, row 2 off at 3.6 s. Row 3 stays off.
Each switch takes 0.2 s with easeOutCubic; the knob slides 30 px (17 → 47).
The track colour blends from grey #d9d7d5 to blue #1f5ae8 with the switch progress.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。三行设置间隔 60 px，并以分隔线分开。x = 450 处有 64×34 轨道（圆角半径 17）和白色滑钮（半径 13，带阴影）。
点击：1.0 秒打开第 1 行，1.8 秒打开第 2 行，3.0 秒关闭第 1 行，3.6 秒关闭第 2 行。第 3 行保持关闭。
每次切换以 easeOutCubic 持续 0.2 秒；滑钮移动 30 px（17 → 47）。
轨道颜色随切换进度从灰色 #d9d7d5 混合至蓝色 #1f5ae8。

use.en: Use it for settings that take effect immediately and have only two states.
use.zh-Hans: 适合只有两种状态、修改后立即生效的设置。

meaning.en: A row of joined buttons that switches the view
meaning.zh-Hans: 一排相连按钮用于切换视图

ask.en: Put a Day / Week / Month segmented control above the chart: the selected background slides over 0.25 s and the chart changes with it.
ask.zh-Hans: 图表上方加日、周、月分段控制器，选中背景用 0.25 s 滑动，图表同步变化。

summary.en: Clicking Day, Week or Month slides a blue highlight across and the bar chart below changes height.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击日、周、月选项时，蓝色选中背景横向滑动，下方柱状图的高度随之改变。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A grey 300×40 base (radius 10) at (121, 12), split into three 100-wide segments: Day, Week, Month (in Japanese).
Selection: blue 92×32, radius 8, shadow blur 6; the selected label is white.
The cursor clicks Week at 1.0 s, Month at 2.1 s and Day at 3.3 s; the selection slides over 0.25 s each with easeInOutCubic.
Chart below: seven bars 34 wide, 58 px apart (the sixth is blue). Heights move between three data sets (about 30–85, 40–100, 60–115) together with the selection, eased the same way.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。灰色底座 300×40（圆角半径 10），位于 (121, 12)，分为三个宽 100 的分段：日、周、月（日文）。
选中背景：蓝色 92×32，圆角半径 8，阴影模糊 6；选中标签为白色。
光标在 1.0 秒点击周，2.1 秒点击月，3.3 秒点击日；选中背景每次在 0.25 秒内以 easeInOutCubic 滑动。
下方图表：七根宽 34 的柱子，间隔 58 px（第六根为蓝色）。高度随选中项在三组数据之间变化（约 30–85、40–100、60–115），使用相同缓动。

use.en: Use it to switch between two to four views of the same content, such as day, week and month.
use.zh-Hans: 适合在同一内容的二至四种视图之间切换，例如日、周、月。

meaning.en: Small pills you click to add or remove a filter
meaning.zh-Hans: 点击小标签组合筛选条件

ask.en: Add filter chips above the list: a clicked chip gets a check mark and turns blue, and the list filters within 0.15 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 列表上方加入筛选标签，选中后打勾并变蓝，0.15 s 内更新列表。

summary.en: Clicking the "New" and "Free" chips adds a check mark and turns them blue, and cards that do not match fade out.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击“新品”和“免费”标签后，标签加入对勾并变蓝，不符合条件的卡片淡出。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Four chips ("All, New, Popular, Free" in Japanese): 34 tall, radius 17, width = text + 32, 10 px apart from the left.
Clicks: New on at 0.95 s, Free on at 1.75 s, New off at 3.0 s, Free off at 3.6 s.
Each change takes 0.15 s with easeOutCubic: the chip widens 18 px to make room for a check mark; fill light blue, border and text blue.
List below: four cards (242×54, two columns, two rows); cards that do not match drop from opacity 1 to 0.12.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。四个标签（日文的“全部、新品、热门、免费”）：高 34，圆角半径 17，宽度 = 文字宽度 + 32，从左向右间隔 10 px。
点击：0.95 秒选中新品，1.75 秒选中免费，3.0 秒取消新品，3.6 秒取消免费。
每次变化以 easeOutCubic 持续 0.15 秒：标签加宽 18 px 以容纳对勾；填充浅蓝色，边框与文字为蓝色。
下方列表：四张卡片（242×54，两列两行）；不符合条件的卡片不透明度从 1 降至 0.12。

use.en: Use it to let people narrow a list or search results by combining a few quick filters.
use.zh-Hans: 适合让用户组合几个快捷筛选条件，缩小列表或搜索结果范围。

meaning.en: Two handles on one track pick a minimum and a maximum
meaning.zh-Hans: 双滑块选择最小值与最大值

ask.en: Make the price filter a range slider with two handles, showing each value in a bubble while it is dragged.
ask.zh-Hans: 价格筛选改用范围滑块：两个滑块，拖动时在气泡中显示各自数值。

summary.en: On a price slider, the left handle is dragged right and the right handle left to narrow the range, then both go back.
summary.zh-Hans: 价格滑块的左把手向右、右把手向左拖动，缩小区间，随后两者回到原位。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Track: x 54–488, 8 tall, at y 120; the part between the two handles is blue. Range ¥0–¥10,000.
Handles: white, radius 13, 3 px blue rim; while dragged, radius 15 with a light-blue halo of radius 24.
Low handle: 0.1 → 0.3 (¥1,000 → ¥3,000) over 1.0–1.6 s, back over 3.55–3.9 s. High handle: 1.0 → 0.8 (¥10,000 → ¥8,000) over 2.1–2.6 s, back over 2.95–3.3 s. All easeInOutCubic.
A value bubble (28 tall) above each handle, blue with white text while dragged. The range "¥1,000 – ¥10,000" is shown in blue at top right, updated in ¥100 steps.
The cursor sits on the handle it drags (presses at 1.0, 2.1, 2.95 and 3.55 s).
zh-Hans: 把手：白色，半径 13，蓝色边缘宽 3 px；拖动时半径为 15，带有半径 24 的浅蓝光晕。
每个把手上方有数值气泡（高 28），拖动时为蓝底白字。右上角以蓝色显示区间“¥1,000 – ¥10,000”，按 ¥100 步长更新。
光标始终位于当前拖动的把手上（在 1.0、2.1、2.95 和 3.55 秒按下）。

use.en: Use it to filter by a range, such as price, date or size, with a minimum and a maximum.
use.zh-Hans: 适合按价格、日期或尺寸等具有最小值和最大值的区间筛选。

meaning.en: Plus and minus buttons that change a number by one
meaning.zh-Hans: 通过加减按钮逐次修改数值

ask.en: Make the quantity field a stepper: + and − change it by one, and the number pops slightly for 0.25 s on each press.
ask.zh-Hans: 数量字段使用步进器，加减每次变化 1，数字每次用 0.25 s 轻弹一下。

summary.en: Pressing + three times raises the number from 1 to 4, and pressing − three times brings it back to 1; the number pops on each press.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击 + 三次，数值从 1 增至 4；点击 − 三次，数值回到 1，每次点击数字都会弹一下。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 200×60 box (radius 12) at (171, 52): "−" in the left 60 px, a blue "+" in the right 60 px, and a bold 30 px number in the middle.
The pressed segment is tinted light blue from 0.05 s before to 0.15 s after each click.
Number: on each press its scale goes linearly from 1.18 back to 1 over 0.25 s, and it is blue meanwhile.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。200×60 的框（圆角半径 12）位于 (171, 52)：左侧 60 px 内为“−”，右侧 60 px 内为蓝色“+”，中间为粗体 30 px 数字。
被按下的分段从每次点击前 0.05 秒至点击后 0.15 秒呈浅蓝色。
数字：每次按下后，缩放在 0.25 秒内线性从 1.18 回到 1，期间文字为蓝色。

use.en: Use it for small whole numbers changed one at a time, such as quantity or number of guests.
use.zh-Hans: 适合逐个调整数量、访客人数等较小的整数。

meaning.en: Numbered buttons that move between pages
meaning.zh-Hans: 通过页码切换列表页面

ask.en: Add pagination under the search results: the current page is a blue circle that moves in 0.2 s on click, and the list is replaced.
ask.zh-Hans: 搜索结果下方加分页，当前页蓝色圆圈用 0.2 s 移动，并替换列表内容。

summary.en: Clicking 2 and then 3 in the page numbers moves the blue circle and swaps the list above; finally it goes back to 1.
summary.zh-Hans: 依次点击页码 2 和 3，蓝色圆形随之移动，上方列表切换；最后回到第 1 页。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. "‹ 1 2 3 4 5 ›" centred, each 36 in diameter with 8 px gaps, at y 160. A blue circle (radius 18) marks the current page, with white text.
The cursor clicks 2 at 1.0 s, 3 at 2.1 s and 1 at 3.3 s.
The blue circle moves 44 px per page over 0.2 s each with easeInOutCubic (88 px at once from 3 back to 1).
The three-row list above dips in opacity 1 → 0 → 1 within 0.2 s either side of 1.05, 2.15 and 3.35 s, and its content changes at the dip.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片上的 4.5 秒周期。“‹ 1 2 3 4 5 ›”居中排列，单项直径 36，间隔 8 px，位于 y = 160。蓝色圆形（半径 18）标记当前页，文字为白色。
光标在 1.0 秒点击 2，2.1 秒点击 3，3.3 秒点击 1。
蓝色圆形每页移动 44 px，每次用 0.2 秒完成 easeInOutCubic 缓动（从 3 回到 1 时一次移动 88 px）。
上方三行列表在 1.05、2.15 和 3.35 秒前后各 0.2 秒内，按 1 → 0 → 1 改变不透明度，并在最低点替换内容。

use.en: Use it to split a long list, such as search results or articles, into numbered pages.
use.zh-Hans: 适合将搜索结果或文章等长列表拆分成带编号的页面。

meaning.en: A three-line icon that opens the menu
meaning.zh-Hans: 三横线图标点击后展开菜单

ask.en: Put a hamburger menu at the right of the mobile header: on tap, morph the three lines into × in 0.3 s and drop the menu down from the top.
ask.zh-Hans: 移动端页头右侧放汉堡菜单，点击后用 0.3 s 变成 ×，菜单从顶部展开。

summary.en: Clicking the three-line icon at the header's right turns it into ×, and a menu drops down from under the header; clicking again closes it.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击页头右侧的三横线图标后，图标变为 ×，菜单从页头下方下拉；再次点击则关闭。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A white 44-tall header; three lines (24 long, 3 thick, 8 px apart) at (500, 22) on the right.
The cursor clicks at 1.0 s and 3.3 s. Open amount a: 0→1 over 1.0–1.3 s, 1→0 over 3.3–3.6 s, easeInOutCubic.
Lines to ×: the top and bottom lines move 8 px to the centre and rotate ±45°; the middle line fades with opacity 1 − a. Blue while open.
Menu: white, 140 tall, top at y = 44 − 140 + 140·a so it drops from under the header (clipped below the header), shadow blur 16, four items, the first blue.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。白色页头高 44；右侧 (500, 22) 处放置三条线，长 24、粗 3、间距 8 px。
光标在 1.0 s 和 3.3 s 点击。展开程度 a：1.0–1.3 s 从 0→1，3.3–3.6 s 从 1→0，使用 easeInOutCubic。
三横线变为 ×：上下两条线向中央移动 8 px，同时分别旋转 ±45°；中间线以不透明度 1 − a 淡出。展开期间显示蓝色。
菜单为白色，高 140，顶部 y = 44 − 140 + 140·a，因此从页头下方下拉（只显示页头以下的部分）；阴影模糊 16，内含四项，第一项为蓝色。

use.en: Use it on narrow screens to tuck the main navigation behind one button.
use.zh-Hans: 适合在窄屏上将主导航收进一个按钮中。

meaning.en: A trail of links showing where the page sits in the site
meaning.zh-Hans: 显示页面层级位置的链接路径

ask.en: Add breadcrumbs above the article: "Home › Courses › Web design", with the current page in bold and not linked.
ask.zh-Hans: 文章上方加首页 › 课程 › 网页设计面包屑，当前页加粗且不作为链接。

summary.en: Clicking "Courses" in the breadcrumbs goes up to the list page; clicking a card there returns to the detail page.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击面包屑中的“课程”返回上一级列表页；点击列表卡片则回到详情页。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. At the top "Home › Courses › Web design" (in Japanese, 17 px): links blue, current page black and bold; a divider at y 46.
The cursor hovers "Courses" (underline 0.9–1.2 s) and clicks at 1.0 s.
Up amount: 0→1 over 1.0–1.25 s with easeInOutCubic. "› Web design" fades out and "Courses" becomes the current page (black, bold).
Content cross-fades from a detail page (title and text) to a list of three cards (158×118, with a landscape picture).
Back: the cursor moves onto the first card (blue outline 2.45–2.8 s) and clicks at 2.7 s; the detail page returns over 2.7–2.95 s.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。顶部显示“首页 › 课程 › 网页设计”（日文，17 px）；链接为蓝色，当前页为黑色粗体；y 46 处有分隔线。
光标悬停在“课程”上（0.9–1.2 s 显示下划线），并在 1.0 s 点击。
返回上级的进度在 1.0–1.25 s 以 easeInOutCubic 从 0→1。“› 网页设计”淡出，“课程”变成当前页（黑色、粗体）。
内容从详情页（标题和正文）交叉淡化为含三张卡片的列表（158×118，带风景图片）。
返回详情：光标移到第一张卡片上（2.45–2.8 s 显示蓝色描边），2.7 s 点击；详情页在 2.7–2.95 s 恢复。

use.en: Use it on sites with deep hierarchies to show where the page is and give a way back up.
use.zh-Hans: 用于层级较深的网站，显示当前位置并提供返回上级的入口。

meaning.en: A wide panel of grouped links that opens from the main menu
meaning.zh-Hans: 主导航展开的宽幅分组链接面板

ask.en: Give "Products" in the header a mega menu: on hover, drop a full-width panel in 0.25 s with three columns of links and an image.
ask.zh-Hans: 给页头的“产品”加上巨型菜单：悬停后用 0.25 s 展开全宽面板，包含三列链接和一张图。

summary.en: Hovering over "Products" in the header drops a full-width panel with three columns of links and an image; it closes when the cursor leaves.
summary.zh-Hans: 悬停页头的“产品”会下拉一个全宽面板，内含三列链接和一张图片；光标离开后关闭。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 42-tall header with "Products, Pricing, Support" (in Japanese, 16 px, each with a down chevron).
The cursor only hovers: it reaches "Products" at 1.0 s. Open amount a: 0→1 over 1.05–1.3 s with easeOutCubic; "Products" turns blue with an underline.
Panel: white, full width, 146 tall, dropping 12 px into place under the header while fading in with a. Shadow blur 18, offset y 8.

Inside: three columns 130 px apart (a blue heading and three links each) and a 104×112 picture at the right. The cursor moves down and the second link of the second column is highlighted light blue from 1.75 to 2.9 s.
Close: the cursor leaves the panel from 2.9 s; it fades over 3.15–3.4 s (1 − easeInOutCubic).
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。页头高 42，包含“产品、价格、支持”（日文，16 px，各带向下箭头）。
光标仅悬停，不点击：1.0 s 到达“产品”。展开程度 a 在 1.05–1.3 s 以 easeOutCubic 从 0→1；“产品”变蓝并显示下划线。
面板为白色、全宽、高 146，在页头下方向下移动 12 px 就位，同时按 a 淡入。阴影模糊 18，y 偏移 8。
内部有间距 130 px 的三列内容（每列一个蓝色标题、三个链接），右侧有一张 104×112 图片。光标下移，第二列第二个链接在 1.75–2.9 s 以浅蓝色高亮。
关闭：光标从 2.9 s 起离开面板；面板在 3.15–3.4 s 淡出（1 − easeInOutCubic）。

use.en: Use it on sites with many products or sections so visitors can see the whole range at once.
use.zh-Hans: 适合产品或栏目较多的网站，让访客一次看清全部内容。

meaning.en: Shows which step of a process you are on
meaning.zh-Hans: 显示流程的当前步骤与进度

ask.en: Add a step indicator above the sign-up form with four steps: Details, Review, Payment, Done; completed steps show a check.
ask.zh-Hans: 注册表单顶部放信息、确认、支付、完成四步指示器，已完成步骤显示勾。

summary.en: Each click on "Next" turns the next of four step circles into a check and extends the blue line to the following step.
summary.zh-Hans: 每点击一次“下一步”，四个步骤圆中的下一个就变成勾号，蓝线延伸至后续步骤。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Four steps ("Details, Review, Payment, Done" in Japanese) at x 80, 207, 334, 461, y 35; circles of radius 17 joined by a 4 px grey line.
The cursor clicks "Next" (110×38, bottom right) at 0.9, 1.7 and 2.5 s.
On each click the current step becomes a blue circle with a white check and the next becomes the current one (blue circle, white number). Steps not reached are white with a grey rim.
The blue line grows 127 px per click over 0.3 s with easeInOutCubic; after the third click all four are checked.
Reset: the indicator fades out over 3.75–4.05 s and fades back in at step 1 over 4.05–4.3 s.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。四个步骤（“详情、确认、付款、完成”，日文）位于 x 80、207、334、461，y 35；圆半径 17，以 4 px 灰线连接。
每次点击，当前步骤变成带白色勾号的蓝圆，下一步成为当前步骤（蓝圆、白色数字）。未到达的步骤为白色、灰色边框。
每次点击，蓝线在 0.3 s 内以 easeInOutCubic 延长 127 px；第三次点击后四个步骤全部显示勾号。
重置：指示器在 3.75–4.05 s 淡出，在 4.05–4.3 s 以第 1 步状态淡入。

use.en: Use it in multi-step flows such as sign-up or checkout to show progress and what is left.
use.zh-Hans: 用于注册、结账等多步流程，显示进度和剩余步骤。

meaning.en: Grey shapes stand in for content while it loads
meaning.zh-Hans: 加载时以灰色块预示内容布局

ask.en: While the list loads, show a skeleton screen: grey blocks in the shape of the content, with a shine sweeping left to right every 0.9 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 列表加载时显示骨架屏，灰块形状对应内容，每 0.9 s 从左向右扫一道光。

summary.en: Clicking reload turns the list into grey blocks of the same shape with a sweeping shine; the content returns when loading ends.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击重新加载后，列表变成形状相同的灰色块，亮光扫过其表面；加载结束后恢复内容。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A two-row list (a 96×56 picture and three text lines each). The cursor clicks the reload icon at top right at 1.0 s.
Over 1.05–1.2 s (linear) the content switches to grey #e9e7e5 rounded blocks of the same size and position.
Shine: a white band 160 wide (transparent at the edges, opacity 0.75 in the middle) sweeps from x −200 to x 742 every 0.9 s, drawn only over the blocks.
The content returns over 3.0–3.3 s (linear).
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。两行列表，每行有一张 96×56 图片和三行文字。光标在 1.0 s 点击右上角的重新加载图标。
1.05–1.2 s 期间以线性变化，将内容切换为尺寸、位置相同的 #e9e7e5 灰色圆角块。
扫光：宽 160 的白色光带（边缘透明，中间不透明度 0.75）每 0.9 s 从 x −200 扫至 x 742，仅绘制在块内。
内容在 3.0–3.3 s 以线性变化恢复。

use.en: Use it for lists or cards that take a moment to load, so the layout is visible while people wait.
use.zh-Hans: 适合加载需要片刻的列表或卡片，让用户等待时仍能看见布局。

meaning.en: A spinning circle that means "please wait"
meaning.zh-Hans: 旋转圆环表示等待

ask.en: While sending, show a spinner over the form, turning a little over once per second, then replace it with a blue check when done.
ask.zh-Hans: 发送时在表单上方显示每秒转一圈多的加载圆环，完成后换成蓝色勾。

summary.en: Clicking "Send" washes the card white and a blue arc spins in the middle; when finished it changes to a check and fades.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击“发送”后，卡片上覆盖一层白色，中央的蓝色圆弧开始旋转；完成后变成勾号并淡出。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. The cursor clicks "Send" (120×40, bottom centre) at 1.0 s.
Over 1.05–1.2 s (linear) a white scrim (opacity 0.78) and the spinner fade in over the whole card.
Spinner at (271, 92): a pale ring, radius 26, 6 thick, with a blue 243° (1.35π) arc on top (round caps), turning 1.3 times per second (468°/s).
Over 2.95–3.05 s the spinner fades; over 2.95–3.2 s a blue circle (radius 28) with a white check scales 0.7 → 1 (easeOutCubic).
Everything fades out linearly over 3.75–4.0 s.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。光标在 1.0 s 点击底部中央的“发送”（120×40）。
1.05–1.2 s 期间以线性变化，在整张卡片上淡入白色遮罩（不透明度 0.78）和加载圆环。
加载圆环位于 (271, 92)：浅色底环半径 26、粗 6，上方为 243°（1.35π）的蓝色圆弧，端点为圆头，每秒旋转 1.3 圈（468°/s）。
加载圆环在 2.95–3.05 s 淡出；带白色勾号的蓝圆（半径 28）在 2.95–3.2 s 从 0.7→1 缩放（easeOutCubic）。
全部内容在 3.75–4.0 s 线性淡出。

use.en: Use it for short waits of unknown length, such as sending or saving.
use.zh-Hans: 适合发送、保存等时长未知的短暂等待。

meaning.en: A small dot with a number showing a count
meaning.zh-Hans: 用小圆点或数字显示数量

ask.en: Add a badge to the bell in the header to show the unread count: it pops for 0.3 s each time the count goes up and disappears when opened.
ask.zh-Hans: 页头铃铛上显示未读数徽标，数量增加时弹跳 0.3 s，打开后消失。

summary.en: Each time a notification arrives, the blue dot on the bell in the header counts up 1, 2, 3; clicking the bell clears it.
summary.zh-Hans: 每来一条通知，页头铃铛上的蓝色圆点就依次计数为 1、2、3；点击铃铛后清除。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A 54-tall header with a line-drawn bell at (482, 27) on the right.
Badge: a blue circle of radius 12 at the bell's top right (+12, −12), 2.5 px white rim, white 14 px number.
Notifications arrive at 0.7, 1.3 and 1.9 s: the count goes 1 → 2 → 3. The first scales in over 0.7–0.9 s with easeOutCubic.
Each arrival pops the scale from 1.3 back to 1 over 0.3 s and sends out a ripple ring (radius 12 → 28, opacity 0.5 → 0) over 0.5 s.
The cursor reaches the bell at 2.95 s and clicks at 3.0 s; the badge shrinks to 0 over 3.0–3.25 s with easeInOutCubic.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。页头高 54，右侧 (482, 27) 处为线条铃铛图标。
徽标：位于铃铛右上方 (+12, −12) 的蓝圆，半径 12，白色边框 2.5 px，白色数字 14 px。
通知在 0.7、1.3、1.9 s 到达，计数 1→2→3。第一次在 0.7–0.9 s 以 easeOutCubic 缩放入场。
每条通知使缩放在 0.3 s 内从 1.3 弹回 1，并在 0.5 s 内发出一圈涟漪（半径 12→28，不透明度 0.5→0）。
光标在 2.95 s 到达铃铛，3.0 s 点击；徽标在 3.0–3.25 s 以 easeInOutCubic 缩小到 0。

use.en: Use it to call attention to a count, such as unread messages or items in a cart.
use.zh-Hans: 用于突出未读消息、购物车商品等数量。

meaning.en: The screen shown when there is nothing to list yet
meaning.zh-Hans: 列表没有内容时显示的界面

ask.en: When the list is empty, show an empty state: a line icon, "Nothing here yet" and an add button, fading in over 0.35 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 列表为空时显示空状态：线描图标、“暂无内容”和添加按钮，用 0.35 s 淡入。

summary.en: Deleting the two list rows with their trash icons brings up an empty-box drawing, "Nothing here yet" and an "Add" button.
summary.zh-Hans: 用垃圾桶图标删除两行列表后，显示空盒插画、“这里还没有内容”和“添加”按钮。

en: 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A two-row list (494×48, radius 8, a trash icon at the right).
The cursor clicks the trash icons at 0.95 s and 1.65 s. Each row slides 60 px left while fading out over 0.3 s (easeInOutCubic); the second row moves up 58 px into the first slot.
Over 1.95–2.3 s (linear) the empty state fades in while rising 8 px: a blue line drawing of an inbox tray, "Nothing here yet" (16 px, in Japanese) and a blue "Add" button (112×34).
The cursor clicks "Add" at 3.3 s; the empty state fades over 3.25–3.45 s and the two rows come back from the left over 3.35–3.7 s with easeOutCubic.
zh-Hans: 542×191 卡片，循环 4.5 s。两行列表，尺寸 494×48、圆角 8，右侧有垃圾桶图标。
光标在 0.95 s 和 1.65 s 点击垃圾桶图标。每行在 0.3 s 内向左滑动 60 px 并淡出（easeInOutCubic）；第二行上移 58 px 到第一行的位置。
1.95–2.3 s 期间，空状态线性淡入并上移 8 px：蓝色线条收件箱插画、“这里还没有内容”（16 px，日文）和蓝色“添加”按钮（112×34）。
光标在 3.3 s 点击“添加”；空状态在 3.25–3.45 s 淡出，两行列表在 3.35–3.7 s 以 easeOutCubic 从左侧返回。

use.en: Use it for first-use screens or no-results pages to tell people what to do next.
use.zh-Hans: 用于首次使用或无结果页面，告诉用户下一步可以做什么。

meaning.en: On scroll, background layers move slower than the content
meaning.zh-Hans: 滚动时背景层比内容移动得慢

ask.en: Make the hero background a parallax scroll: move it at 0.3× the scroll distance.
ask.zh-Hans: 让首屏背景以滚动距离的 0.3× 移动，形成视差滚动。

summary.en: As the page scrolls down, the headline moves up normally while the sky and sun, far hills and near hills move more slowly.
summary.zh-Hans: 页面向下滚动时，标题以正常速度上移，天空与太阳、远山、近山则移动得更慢。

en: A browser window with a 511 × 168 viewport. Scroll: 0→120 px at 0.3–1.9 s, 120→0 at 2.9–4.3 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Each layer moves by scroll × factor: sky and sun 0.15, far hills 0.4, near hills 0.7.
Headline (28 px), button and the next section move at 1.0 (normal scrolling).
The next section (white) starts at the bottom of the hero (168 px) and slides over the slower background.
The scrollbar thumb on the right moves with the scroll.
zh-Hans: 浏览器视口为 511×168。滚动量：0.3–1.9 s 从 0→120 px，2.9–4.3 s 从 120→0（cubic ease-in-out）。
各层位移为滚动量 × 系数：天空与太阳 0.15，远山 0.4，近山 0.7。
标题（28 px）、按钮和下一区块按 1.0 倍速度移动，即正常滚动。
下一个白色区块从首屏主视觉底部（168 px）开始，在移动较慢的背景上方滑过。
右侧滚动条滑块随滚动量移动。

use.en: Use it to give the hero or a section photo a sense of depth.
use.zh-Hans: 为首屏主视觉或区块照片增加纵深感。

meaning.en: Elements fade in as they scroll into view
meaning.zh-Hans: 元素进入视口时逐渐出现

ask.en: Fade in each section's heading and cards on scroll: up from 30 px below, over 0.6 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 标题和卡片滚动进入视口时，从下方 30 px 在 0.6 s 内上移淡入。

summary.en: As the page scrolls, the heading, the cards and the body text each rise into place and fade in when they enter the view.
summary.zh-Hans: 页面滚动时，标题、卡片和正文进入视口后，各自向上就位并淡入。

en: Scroll: 0→95 px at 0.35–1.0 s, 95→200 px at 1.5–2.1 s, 200→0 at 3.2–4.4 s (all cubic ease-in-out).
Trigger line at 85% of the viewport height (143 px from the top). An element fires when its top edge passes above it (the Intersection Observer idea).
After firing, over 0.7 s: opacity 0→1 and offset 28 px below → 0 (cubic ease-out).
Three elements: the heading (172 px down the page), a row of three cards (206 px) and body text (334 px), all below the view at first. The cards in the row appear together.
When an element leaves the bottom of the view on the way back up, it is reset out of sight and plays again next time.
zh-Hans: 触发线位于视口高度的 85%（距顶部 143 px）。元素顶边越过此线向上移动时触发，采用 Intersection Observer 的思路。
触发后的 0.7 s 内：不透明度 0→1，垂直偏移从下方 28 px→0（cubic ease-out）。
三个元素：标题位于页面向下 172 px 处，一排三张卡片位于 206 px 处，正文位于 334 px 处，初始均在视口下方。同排卡片同时出现。
向上回滚时，元素从视口底部离开后，在视野外重置，下次进入时重新播放。

use.en: Use it on a long landing page to bring content in piece by piece as the reader scrolls.
use.zh-Hans: 适合较长的落地页，让内容随着阅读逐段出现。

meaning.en: The header stays at the top while the page scrolls
meaning.zh-Hans: 滚动时页头停留在屏幕顶部

ask.en: Make the header a sticky header, with a soft shadow once it sticks to the top.
ask.zh-Hans: 把页头设为吸顶，到达顶部后加一层柔和阴影。

summary.en: The announcement strip scrolls away, but the header below it stops at the top edge and the content scrolls underneath.
summary.zh-Hans: 公告条随滚动消失，但其下的页头停在顶边，内容从它下方继续滚动。

en: Scroll: 0→110 px at 0.4–1.3 s, 110→250 px at 1.9–2.8 s, 250→0 at 3.4–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
At the very top, a 22 px announcement strip (navy); below it a 34 px header (logo, three menu items, button).
Header position = max(22 − scroll, 0): once the strip is gone, it stops at the top edge (position: sticky; top: 0).
Over the next 24 px of scroll, a 12 px shadow under the header fades from 0 to 0.16 opacity.
The content (photo, heading, three cards) scrolls normally under the header.
zh-Hans: 最上方为 22 px 高的藏青色公告条，下方为 34 px 高的页头（标志、三个菜单项、按钮）。
页头位置 = max(22 − 滚动量, 0)：公告条消失后，页头停在顶边（position: sticky; top: 0）。
随后滚动 24 px 的过程中，页头下方的 12 px 阴影不透明度从 0 增至 0.16。
内容（照片、标题、三张卡片）在页头下方正常滚动。

use.en: Use it to keep the menu and the call-to-action within reach on a long page.
use.zh-Hans: 让长页面中的菜单和行动按钮始终易于触达。

meaning.en: A section stays fixed while scrolling advances its content
meaning.zh-Hans: 区块固定，滚动推动内部内容变化

ask.en: Pin the three-step section and switch the photo and number one step at a time as the user scrolls.
ask.zh-Hans: 固定三步骤区块，用户滚动时逐步切换照片和编号。

summary.en: A navy section stops when it fills the view; further scrolling steps the number and photo through 1→2→3, then the section scrolls on.
summary.zh-Hans: 藏青色区块占满视口后固定不动；继续滚动会让数字与照片依次切换 1→2→3，之后区块继续滚走。

en: Scroll: 0→500 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 500→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
The section (168 tall, navy) reaches the top at 110 px of scroll and stays there for the next 300 px (a GSAP ScrollTrigger pin).
Progress while pinned: p = (scroll − 110) / 300. A vertical line (124 long) on the left fills in orange with p.
At p = 1/3 and 2/3 (±0.07, cubic ease-in-out) it moves to the next step: the number (46 px) rolls up 52 px and the photo (226 × 124) slides up 124 px.
After 300 px the pin is released and the section scrolls up with the white section below it.
zh-Hans: 滚动量：0.3–3.0 s 为 0→500 px，3.5–4.5 s 为 500→0（cubic ease-in-out）。
区块高 168、藏青色，在滚动 110 px 时到达顶部，并在接下来的 300 px 滚动中保持固定（GSAP ScrollTrigger pin）。
固定期间的进度 p = (滚动量 − 110) / 300。左侧长 124 的竖线按 p 填充橙色。
在 p = 1/3 和 2/3 时切换下一步（±0.07，cubic ease-in-out）：数字（46 px）向上滚动 52 px，照片（226×124）向上滑动 124 px。
经过 300 px 后解除固定，区块与其下的白色区块一起向上滚动。

use.en: Use it to walk through steps, features or a before/after in one screen.
use.zh-Hans: 用于在一个屏幕中讲解步骤、功能或前后对比。

meaning.en: Scrolling down moves the content sideways
meaning.zh-Hans: 纵向滚动驱动内容横移

ask.en: Turn the work section into a horizontal scroll: move the cards left as far as the user scrolls down.
ask.zh-Hans: 把作品区做成横向滚动：向下滚动多少，卡片就向左移动多少。

summary.en: As the page scrolls down, the section holds still and four numbered work cards travel to the left.
summary.zh-Hans: 页面向下滚动时，区块保持不动，四张带编号的作品卡片向左移动。

en: Scroll: 0→420 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 420→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
The heading "WORKS" scrolls away; the section reaches the top at 40 px of scroll and stays there.
Cards: four at 200 × 112, gap 20, side padding 34. Horizontal travel = 34·2 + 200·4 + 20·3 − 511 = 417 px.
Card x = start x − p × 417, with p = (scroll − 40) / 380: linear in scroll, no easing.
The scrollbar thumb moves down while the cards move sideways.
zh-Hans: 滚动量：0.3–3.0 s 为 0→420 px，3.5–4.5 s 为 420→0（cubic ease-in-out）。
“WORKS”标题随滚动消失；区块在滚动 40 px 时到达顶部并保持固定。
卡片 x = 起始 x − p × 417，其中 p = (滚动量 − 40) / 380；随滚动线性变化，不使用缓动。
卡片横向移动时，滚动条滑块向下移动。

use.en: Use it to show work, case studies or products in a row inside a long vertical page.
use.zh-Hans: 用于在长竖向页面中横向展示作品、案例或产品。

meaning.en: Scrolling settles exactly on the next section
meaning.zh-Hans: 滚动结束时自动对齐区块

ask.en: Add scroll snap per section, so a small scroll lands on the top of the next section.
ask.zh-Hans: 让页面按区块滚动吸附，轻滚一下就落到下一节顶部。

summary.en: After a small scroll, the page carries itself the rest of the way until the next section's top lines up with the top of the view.
summary.zh-Hans: 轻微滚动后，页面自动继续移动，直到下一区块顶部与视口顶部对齐。

en: Each section is as tall as the viewport (168 px). The first is pale blue, the second navy.
One snap per 2.4 s. At 0.45–0.85 s the user scrolls only 34 px (cubic ease-out).
At 0.9–1.5 s the page moves the remaining 134 px by itself and lines up the next section's top (cubic ease-out).
The second 2.4 s does the same upward, back to the first section (the behaviour of scroll-snap-type: y mandatory).
zh-Hans: 每个区块与视口等高（168 px）。第一个为浅蓝色，第二个为藏青色。
每 2.4 s 吸附一次。0.45–0.85 s 期间，用户只滚动 34 px（cubic ease-out）。
0.9–1.5 s 期间，页面自行移动剩余的 134 px，使下一区块顶部对齐（cubic ease-out）。
第二个 2.4 s 以相同方式向上移动，返回第一个区块，表现与 scroll-snap-type: y mandatory 一致。

use.en: Use it for a page that should read one full screen at a time, like slides.
use.zh-Hans: 用于像幻灯片一样每次阅读整屏内容的页面。

meaning.en: A bar at the top shows how far you have read
meaning.zh-Hans: 顶部条显示阅读进度

ask.en: Add a scroll progress bar at the top of the article page, 4 px thick, in the brand orange.
ask.zh-Hans: 文章顶部放 4 px 厚的品牌橙色滚动进度条。

summary.en: As the article is read a bit at a time, the line along the top grows from the left and reaches the far end at the bottom of the page.
summary.zh-Hans: 文章逐段阅读时，顶部横线从左侧不断增长，到达页面底部时延伸至最右端。

en: The article scrolls 0→430 px in four 110 px steps, each moving for 0.45 s then pausing 0.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
It returns 430→0 at 3.75–4.55 s.
A 6 px bar along the top of the viewport: light grey track, orange fill.
Fill width = 511 px × scroll / 430, the scroll fraction itself (the same as CSS animation-timeline: scroll()).
zh-Hans: 文章分四次、每次 110 px 从 0 滚到 430 px；每次移动 0.45 s 后停顿 0.4 s（cubic ease-in-out）。
视口顶部有一条 6 px 高的进度条：浅灰色轨道、橙色填充。
填充宽度 = 511 px × 滚动量 / 430，直接等于滚动进度比例，与 CSS animation-timeline: scroll() 相同。

use.en: Use it on long articles to show how much is left to read.
use.zh-Hans: 用于长文章，显示还剩多少内容未读。

meaning.en: A highlighter stroke is drawn under key words
meaning.zh-Hans: 重点文字下方逐渐画出色带

ask.en: When the key phrase scrolls into view, draw a yellow highlighter animation under it, left to right in 0.8 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 关键词进入视口时，在下方用 0.8 s 从左向右画出黄色荧光标记。

summary.en: As the copy scrolls into view, a yellow highlighter stroke is drawn left to right across the lower half of the key words.
summary.zh-Hans: 文案滚入视口时，关键词下半部出现一道从左向右绘制的黄色荧光笔划。

en: Scroll: 0→90 px at 0.35–1.0 s, 90→180 px at 1.6–2.2 s, 180→0 at 3.3–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Two lines of copy (20 px, bold) at 190 px and 290 px down the page, hidden below the view at first.
When a line's top passes the trigger line (80% of the viewport height, 134 px), the stroke under its key words starts.
Stroke: yellow #FFE36B, 11 tall, in the lower part of the text (8 px above to 3 px below the baseline). Width 0 → word width from the left over 0.8 s (cubic ease-out), drawn behind the text.
Lines that leave the bottom of the view are reset out of sight.
zh-Hans: 两行文案（20 px，粗体）位于页面向下 190 px 和 290 px 处，初始隐藏在视口下方。
某行顶部越过触发线（视口高度的 80%，即 134 px）后，其关键词下方开始绘制笔划。
笔划为黄色 #FFE36B，高 11，位于文字下部（基线上方 8 px 到下方 3 px）。宽度在 0.8 s 内从左侧由 0 增至关键词宽度（cubic ease-out），绘制于文字背后。
离开视口底部的文字行在视野外重置。

use.en: Use it in landing-page copy to make the one phrase that matters stand out as it is read.
use.zh-Hans: 用于落地页文案，让关键短语在阅读时更加突出。

meaning.en: On hover, the element rises with a deeper shadow
meaning.zh-Hans: 悬停时元素抬高并加深阴影

ask.en: Give the cards a hover lift: up 8 px with a deeper shadow, over 0.3 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 给卡片加上悬停抬升：光标悬停时用 0.3 s 抬高 8 px，同时加深阴影。

summary.en: Only the card under the cursor lifts slightly and its shadow spreads; it settles back when the cursor leaves.
summary.zh-Hans: 只有光标下方的卡片会轻轻抬起、阴影扩散；光标离开时恢复原位。

en: Three cards (146 × 128, radius 10). The cursor rests on each, left to right, for about 1 s.
On hover the card rises 10 px over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over the same 0.3 s (like a CSS transition).
Shadow, changed together with the lift: blur 6→22 px, y offset 2→12 px, opacity 0.08→0.22.
Light grey page, white cards, so the shadow reads.
zh-Hans: 三张卡片，146×128、圆角 10。光标从左到右，在每张上停留约 1 s。
悬停时，卡片在 0.3 s 内上移 10 px（cubic ease-out）；离开时用相同的 0.3 s 返回，类似 CSS transition。
阴影与抬升同步变化：模糊 6→22 px，y 偏移 2→12 px，不透明度 0.08→0.22。
页面为浅灰色，卡片为白色，使阴影清晰可见。

use.en: Use it to make cards and buttons look clickable.
use.zh-Hans: 让卡片和按钮显得可以点击。

meaning.en: The photo enlarges inside a fixed frame
meaning.zh-Hans: 图片在固定边框内放大

ask.en: Add an image zoom on hover to the work photos: fixed frame, content to 1.1× over 0.5 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 给作品照片加上悬停图片放大：外框不变，内容用 0.5 s 放大到 1.1×。

summary.en: The photo under the cursor slowly enlarges while its frame stays the same size, and shrinks back when the cursor leaves.
summary.zh-Hans: 光标下的照片缓慢放大，外框尺寸保持不变；光标离开时缩回。

en: Two photo frames, 222 × 118 (radius 8). The cursor rests on the left one, then the right one, for about 1.5 s each.
On hover the content scales 1→1.15 from the centre over 0.5 s (cubic ease-out); on leave it returns over 0.5 s.
Anything outside the frame is clipped (overflow: hidden). The frame and the caption do not move.
zh-Hans: 两个照片框，222×118、圆角 8。光标先后在左、右框上各停留约 1.5 s。
悬停时，内容在 0.5 s 内从中心缩放 1→1.15（cubic ease-out）；离开时用 0.5 s 返回。
超出外框的内容被裁切（overflow: hidden）。外框和图片说明不移动。

use.en: Use it on photo grids (work, products, articles) to show which item is about to be chosen.
use.zh-Hans: 适合照片网格中的作品、产品或文章，提示即将选择的项目。

meaning.en: A shape trails the mouse pointer with a delay
meaning.zh-Hans: 图形略带延迟地跟随指针

ask.en: Add a cursor follower across the site: a 30 px orange circle that trails the pointer slightly.
ask.zh-Hans: 全站加入光标跟随：一个直径 30 px 的橙色圆，稍有延迟地跟随光标。

summary.en: As the cursor moves around the page, an orange circle follows it a little behind.
summary.zh-Hans: 光标在页面上移动时，一个橙色圆会稍稍滞后地跟随它。

en: Cursor path: x = 255 + 175·sin(2πt/4.8), y = 86 + 46·sin(4πt/4.8) (a figure eight lying on its side, one lap per 4.8 s).
Circle: radius 17, orange, opacity 0.88, drawn under the cursor.
Follow rule: every frame (60 fps) it covers 12% of the remaining distance (x += (cursor x − x) × 0.12).
The arrow cursor stays visible.
zh-Hans: 光标路径：x = 255 + 175·sin(2πt/4.8)，y = 86 + 46·sin(4πt/4.8)，构成横置的 8 字形，每 4.8 s 一圈。
圆形半径 17、橙色、不透明度 0.88，绘制在光标下方。
跟随规则：每帧（60 fps）走完剩余距离的 12%（x += (光标 x − x) × 0.12）。
箭头光标保持可见。

use.en: Use it on brand sites and portfolios to add a playful, hands-on feel.
use.zh-Hans: 用于品牌网站和作品集，增加活泼、可互动的感觉。

meaning.en: The button is pulled toward a nearby cursor
meaning.zh-Hans: 按钮向附近光标偏移

ask.en: Make the contact button a magnetic button: move 0.3× toward the cursor, and spring back when it leaves.
ask.zh-Hans: 把联系按钮做成磁吸按钮：向光标方向移动两者距离的 0.3×，移开后弹回原位。

summary.en: As the cursor comes near, the button is drawn toward it and follows; when the cursor leaves, the button wobbles back to its place.
summary.zh-Hans: 光标靠近时，按钮被吸向光标并随之移动；光标离开后，按钮晃动着回到原位。

en: A 168 × 52 button (orange, radius 26) in the centre. The pull range is a 110 px radius from the button's centre.
Inside the range: target offset = (cursor − button centre) × 0.35; every frame (60 fps) the button covers 18% of the way to the target.
On leaving the range it returns from its current offset to 0 over 1.1 s with elastic.out(1, 0.3): 2^(−10x)·sin((x − 0.075)·2π/0.3) + 1.
The cursor enters from the left, circles the button and leaves to the right.
zh-Hans: 中央放置一个 168×52 的橙色按钮，圆角 26。吸引范围为以按钮中心为圆心、半径 110 px 的区域。
范围内：目标偏移 = (光标 − 按钮中心) × 0.35；每帧（60 fps）按钮走完到目标距离的 18%。
离开范围后，按钮在 1.1 s 内从当前偏移返回 0，使用 elastic.out(1, 0.3)：2^(−10x)·sin((x − 0.075)·2π/0.3) + 1。
光标从左侧进入，绕按钮移动，再从右侧离开。

use.en: Use it on the one button you most want clicked, such as sign-up or contact.
use.zh-Hans: 用于最希望用户点击的按钮，例如注册或联系。

meaning.en: A ripple spreads from the point that was pressed
meaning.zh-Hans: 从点击位置扩散的圆形波纹

ask.en: Add a ripple effect to the submit button: a white circle spreads from the click point and fades in 0.6 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 给提交按钮加上涟漪效果：点击时从点击处扩散出白色圆形，在 0.6 s 内淡去。

summary.en: Each click sends a white circle out from the click point to fill the button, then it fades away.
summary.zh-Hans: 每次点击都会从点击处扩散一个白色圆，覆盖按钮后逐渐消失。

en: Button 280 × 56 (orange, radius 10). Clicks at 0.7 s (left of centre) and 2.9 s (right of centre).
The circle is centred on the click point; its radius grows from 0 to the distance to the button's farthest corner over 0.6 s (cubic ease-out).
White at 0.4 opacity, fading to 0 between 0.3 and 0.8 s after the click.
The circle is clipped to the button (overflow: hidden); the label sits above it.
zh-Hans: 按钮 280×56，橙色、圆角 10。0.7 s 点击中心偏左处，2.9 s 点击中心偏右处。
圆以点击位置为圆心，半径在 0.6 s 内从 0 增长到点击点至按钮最远角的距离（cubic ease-out）。
白色、不透明度 0.4，在点击后的 0.3–0.8 s 期间淡至 0。
圆被裁切在按钮内（overflow: hidden），文字标签位于其上方。

use.en: Use it to confirm a press on a button or list item right where it happened.
use.zh-Hans: 在按钮或列表项的实际点击位置确认按下操作。

meaning.en: A link's underline grows from the left on hover
meaning.zh-Hans: 悬停时链接下划线从左展开

ask.en: Add an underline animation to the menu links: grow from the left in 0.3 s on hover, and exit to the right on leave.
ask.zh-Hans: 菜单链接悬停时下划线用 0.3 s 从左长出，移开时向右收起。

summary.en: Under the link the cursor is on, an orange line grows from the left; when the cursor leaves, the line shrinks away to the right.
summary.zh-Hans: 光标悬停的链接下方，一条橙线从左侧伸展；光标离开时，线向右收起消失。

en: Three links (20 px, bold, 56 apart). The cursor rests on each, left to right, for about 1 s (hit area 6 px wider than the text on each side).
Underline: orange, 3 thick, 8 px below the baseline.
On hover, width 0→100% from the left end over 0.3 s (cubic ease-out).
On leave, the left end moves right over 0.3 s, so the line exits to the right (like scaleX with transform-origin on the right).
zh-Hans: 三个链接，20 px、粗体、间距 56。光标从左到右各停留约 1 s，点击区域在文字左右各额外扩展 6 px。
下划线为橙色，粗 3，位于基线下方 8 px。
悬停时，宽度在 0.3 s 内从左端由 0→100%（cubic ease-out）。
离开时，左端在 0.3 s 内向右移动，让线从右侧退出，类似将 transform-origin 放在右侧的 scaleX。

use.en: Use it on menu and text links to show where the pointer is, quietly.
use.zh-Hans: 用于菜单和文字链接，轻量地提示指针位置。

meaning.en: Drag a divider to compare before and after
meaning.zh-Hans: 拖动分隔线比较处理前后

ask.en: Show the project photos as a before/after slider: drag the middle line to compare before on the left and after on the right.
ask.zh-Hans: 项目照片加入前后对比滑块，拖中线比较左侧处理前与右侧处理后。

summary.en: Dragging the line in the middle of the photo left and right changes how much of the grey "before" (left) and the coloured "after" (right) is shown.
summary.zh-Hans: 左右拖动照片中央的分隔线，改变左侧灰色“处理前”与右侧彩色“处理后”的显示比例。

en: Photo frame 359 × 140 (radius 10). Right: the edited photo in colour. Left: the same photo as the "before" (saturation removed, navy at 0.18 opacity on top).
The before image is clipped to the left of the divider. On the divider: a white line (3 wide) and a white circle (radius 17) with left/right arrows.
At 0.7 s the circle is grabbed; the divider goes 50%→20% (0.75–1.55 s) →82% (1.55–2.65 s) →50% (2.65–3.55 s), all cubic ease-in-out.
Released at 3.62 s. Labels BEFORE (top left) and AFTER (top right).
zh-Hans: 照片框 359×140，圆角 10。右侧为彩色处理后照片；左侧为同一张处理前照片，去除饱和度并叠加不透明度 0.18 的藏青色。
处理前图像裁切在分隔线左侧。分隔线上有宽 3 的白线和带左右箭头的白圆（半径 17）。
3.62 s 松开。左上角显示 BEFORE，右上角显示 AFTER。

use.en: Use it on pages that sell a change: renovation, beauty, photo retouching.
use.zh-Hans: 用于展示改造效果的页面，例如翻新、美容、照片修饰。

meaning.en: A popup shown when the visitor is about to leave
meaning.zh-Hans: 访客准备离开时出现的弹窗

ask.en: Add an exit-intent popup to the landing page: when the cursor leaves through the top, show a coupon popup once.
ask.zh-Hans: 光标从落地页顶部离开时，展示一次优惠券挽留弹窗。

summary.en: When the cursor heads out through the top of the page (toward the tabs and close button), the page dims and a "Wait!" popup opens. The × closes it.
summary.zh-Hans: 光标从页面顶部向标签页或关闭按钮移出时，页面变暗并打开“等等！”弹窗。点击 × 可关闭。

en: The cursor rises from the page toward the browser's address bar at 0.7–1.25 s (cubic ease-in-out).
It fires when the cursor crosses the top edge of the viewport (y = 0, at about 1.07 s), the same test as mouseleave on document with clientY ≤ 0.
Opens 0.05–0.45 s after firing (cubic ease-out): backdrop navy 0→0.5 opacity; popup (260 × 132, radius 12) opacity 0→1 and scale 0.9→1.
Inside: a heading, a discount line (orange), a coupon button and an × at the top right.
Click on the × at 2.9 s; it disappears 0.03–0.25 s later (linear).
zh-Hans: 光标在 0.7–1.25 s 从页面向浏览器地址栏上移（cubic ease-in-out）。
光标越过视口顶边时触发（y = 0，约 1.07 s），与 document 的 mouseleave 事件中检查 clientY ≤ 0 相同。
触发后 0.05–0.45 s 打开（cubic ease-out）：藏青色背景遮罩不透明度 0→0.5；弹窗（260×132、圆角 12）不透明度 0→1、缩放 0.9→1。
内部有标题、一行橙色折扣文字、优惠券按钮，以及右上角的 ×。
2.9 s 点击 ×；在此后 0.03–0.25 s 线性消失。

use.en: Use it to make one last offer to visitors who are about to leave without converting.
use.zh-Hans: 用于在访客未完成转化、即将离开时提供最后一次优惠。

meaning.en: A screen shown while the page loads
meaning.zh-Hans: 页面加载期间显示的过渡界面

ask.en: Make a preloader for the site: logo and a percentage, and the screen lifts away at 100%.
ask.zh-Hans: 做一个预加载画面：网站加载时显示标志与百分比，到 100% 后整屏上移退场。

summary.en: On a navy screen the number under the logo counts from 0% to 100%; then the screen lifts away and the page underneath fades in.
summary.zh-Hans: 藏青色屏幕上，标志下方的数字从 0% 增至 100%；随后整屏向上移走，下方页面淡入。

en: A navy screen fills the viewport with a logo, a number (28 px) and a bar (180 × 4).
0→100% at 0.25–2.1 s (cubic ease-out, rounded to whole numbers); the bar fills in orange at the same rate.
At 2.3–2.85 s the whole screen moves up 168 px and out (cubic ease-in-out).
The page heading and photo fade in 0→1 and rise from 14 px below at 2.35–2.95 s (cubic ease-out).
At 4.25–4.75 s the screen comes back down from the top, at 0% (the next load).
zh-Hans: 藏青色屏幕铺满视口，包含标志、数字（28 px）和进度条（180×4）。
0.25–2.1 s 从 0→100%（cubic ease-out，取整）；进度条以相同进度填充橙色。
2.3–2.85 s 整屏上移 168 px 并离开视口（cubic ease-in-out）。
页面标题和照片在 2.35–2.95 s 从 0→1 淡入，并从下方 14 px 处上移（cubic ease-out）。
4.25–4.75 s 屏幕从顶部向下返回，显示 0%，代表下一次加载。

use.en: Use it on image- or video-heavy sites to turn the loading wait into a brand moment.
use.zh-Hans: 用于大量图片或视频的网站，将加载等待变成品牌展示时刻。

meaning.en: Images load only when they come into view
meaning.zh-Hans: 图片接近视口时才开始加载

ask.en: Lazy load the gallery images: grey placeholders until loaded, then fade in over 0.3 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 图片库使用懒加载，先显示灰色占位，载入后用 0.3 s 淡入。

summary.en: As grey placeholders scroll into view, a spinner turns in each, and the images fade in as they arrive. The top row is loaded from the start.
summary.zh-Hans: 灰色占位框滚入视口后，各自出现旋转加载图标，图片加载完成后淡入。首行从一开始就已加载。

en: A 3 × 3 grid of 151 × 92 placeholders; the first row is shown from the start. Scroll: 0→110 px at 0.35–1.1 s, 110→225 px at 1.7–2.5 s, 225→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
Loading starts when a placeholder's top edge passes above the bottom of the viewport (168 px), with each column 0.12 s later than the one to its left.
For 0.45 s a spinner (radius 11, one turn per 0.8 s) turns in the placeholder's centre.
Then the image fades in 0→1 over 0.35 s (cubic ease-out). Unloaded placeholders show an image icon.
Placeholders that leave the bottom of the view are reset out of sight.
zh-Hans: 3×3 网格，每个占位框 151×92，首行从一开始就显示。滚动量：0.35–1.1 s 为 0→110 px，1.7–2.5 s 为 110→225 px，3.5–4.5 s 为 225→0（cubic ease-in-out）。
占位框顶边向上越过视口底部（168 px）时开始加载；每列比其左侧一列晚 0.12 s。
占位框中央的加载圆环旋转 0.45 s，半径 11，每 0.8 s 一圈。
随后图片在 0.35 s 内从 0→1 淡入（cubic ease-out）。未加载的占位框显示图片图标。
从视口底部离开的占位框在视野外重置。

use.en: Use it on image-heavy pages to make the first view load faster.
use.zh-Hans: 用于图片较多的页面，加快首屏加载。

meaning.en: More items load automatically at the bottom
meaning.zh-Hans: 滚动到底部时自动加载更多条目

ask.en: Make the news list an infinite scroll: show a spinner at the bottom and add ten items at a time.
ask.zh-Hans: 把新闻列表做成无限滚动：滚动到底部后显示加载圆环，每次追加十条。

summary.en: Scrolling down to the end of the list brings up a spinner, then three new items are added so reading can go on.
summary.zh-Hans: 向下滚动到列表末尾后出现加载圆环，随后新增三条内容，让阅读得以继续。

en: A list of items (331 × 44, radius 8, 52 apart) with a spinner (radius 10, one turn per 0.8 s) under the last item.
Scroll: 38→116 px at 0.25–0.85 s, 116→194 px at 1.15–1.75 s (cubic ease-in-out); it stops with the end of the list in view.
At 2.6 s three items are added: each fades 0→1 and rises from 10 px below over 0.35 s (cubic ease-out). The spinner moves to the new end.
Each cycle advances by three items (156 px). The content repeats every three items, so the end of the cycle looks the same as the start.
zh-Hans: 列表项 331×44、圆角 8、间距 52，最后一项下方有加载圆环，半径 10，每 0.8 s 一圈。
滚动量：0.25–0.85 s 为 38→116 px，1.15–1.75 s 为 116→194 px（cubic ease-in-out）；列表末尾可见时停止。
2.6 s 添加三项内容：每项在 0.35 s 内从 0→1 淡入，并从下方 10 px 处上移（cubic ease-out）。加载圆环移至新的列表末尾。
每次循环推进三项（156 px）。内容每三项重复，因此循环结束时看起来与开始时一致。

use.en: Use it for feeds and news lists that people should keep reading without paging.
use.zh-Hans: 用于信息流和新闻列表，让用户无需翻页就能持续阅读。

meaning.en: An animation that bridges two pages
meaning.zh-Hans: 连接两个页面的过渡动画

ask.en: Add a page transition: on link click, an orange panel sweeps across left to right and the next page appears.
ask.zh-Hans: 加上页面转场：点击链接时橙色面板从左向右扫过，再显示下一页。

summary.en: Clicking a card in the work list sweeps an orange panel across from the left; the URL changes and the panel exits to the right on the detail page. "Back to list" returns the same way.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击作品列表卡片后，橙色面板从左侧扫过；URL 随之变化，面板在详情页向右退出。“返回列表”以相同方式返回。

en: Click on a card at 0.8 s. At 0.9–1.3 s a panel (orange, full viewport, logo in the centre) enters from the left and covers everything (cubic ease-in-out).
At 1.3 s, while covered, the page and the URL in the address bar (/works → /works/02) switch.
At 1.4–1.85 s the panel exits to the right (cubic ease-in-out).
Click on "← Back to list" at 3.0 s: the panel enters at 3.1–3.5 s, the page switches at 3.5 s and the panel exits at 3.6–4.05 s.
The panel covers the whole viewport, header included.
zh-Hans: 0.8 s 点击卡片。0.9–1.3 s，橙色面板从左侧进入并遮住全部内容（cubic ease-in-out）；面板铺满视口，中央有标志。
1.3 s，在完全遮住时切换页面与地址栏 URL（/works → /works/02）。
1.4–1.85 s 面板向右退出（cubic ease-in-out）。
3.0 s 点击“← 返回列表”：面板在 3.1–3.5 s 进入，3.5 s 切换页面，3.6–4.05 s 退出。
面板覆盖整个视口，包括页头。

use.en: Use it on brand sites and portfolios to link one page to the next.
use.zh-Hans: 用于品牌网站和作品集，连接前后两个页面。

meaning.en: In-page links glide to their target instead of jumping
meaning.zh-Hans: 页内链接平滑移动到目标位置

ask.en: Make the menu's in-page links smooth scroll, stopping below the fixed header.
ask.zh-Hans: 菜单页内链接使用平滑滚动，停止在固定页头下方。

summary.en: Clicking "Pricing" in the menu glides the page down to the pricing section; the up arrow at the bottom right glides it back to the top.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击菜单中的“价格”后，页面平滑下滑至价格区块；右下角向上箭头让页面平滑回到顶部。

en: At 0.9 s the "Pricing" menu item is clicked; scroll goes 0→296 px over 0.95–2.0 s (1.05 s, cubic ease-in-out).
Stop position = top of the pricing section (330 px) − fixed header height (34 px).
Once scroll passes 60 px, a round back-to-top button (radius 15) fades in over the next 40 px at the bottom right.
At 3.1 s that button is clicked; scroll goes 296→0 over 3.15–4.2 s (cubic ease-in-out).
While the pricing section is in view, "Pricing" in the menu turns orange.
zh-Hans: 0.9 s 点击“价格”菜单项；滚动量在 0.95–2.0 s 从 0→296 px（1.05 s，cubic ease-in-out）。
停止位置 = 价格区块顶部（330 px）− 固定页头高度（34 px）。
滚动量超过 60 px 后，右下角圆形回到顶部按钮（半径 15）在接下来的 40 px 滚动过程中淡入。
3.1 s 点击该按钮；滚动量在 3.15–4.2 s 从 296→0（cubic ease-in-out）。
价格区块位于视口中时，菜单中的“价格”变为橙色。

use.en: Use it when a menu or table of contents jumps within the same page, so the reader sees where they went.
use.zh-Hans: 用于菜单或目录在同一页面内跳转，让读者清楚跳到了哪里。

meaning.en: Text or logos scroll across in an endless band
meaning.zh-Hans: 文字或标志组成连续滚动带

ask.en: Run the service names in a marquee from right to left, looping without a gap, at about 80 px per second.
ask.zh-Hans: 用跑马灯让服务名称从右向左无缝循环滚动，速度约 80 px/s。

summary.en: Inside a navy band, large service names separated by orange dots keep moving to the left without a gap.
summary.zh-Hans: 藏青色横带内，大号服务名称以橙色圆点分隔，持续无缝向左移动。

en: Band: 58 tall, navy, full viewport width. Text: 30 px, heavy weight, 1 px letter spacing, white.
One set is four words (WEB DESIGN / BRANDING / MOTION / UI/UX), 64 px apart, with an orange dot (radius 6) in each gap.
Each cycle (4.8 s) moves left by the width of one set (about 881 px here) at constant speed. The set is measured and the offset wraps by that width, so there is no visible seam.
The set is repeated until the viewport width is filled.
zh-Hans: 横带高 58、藏青色、宽度铺满视口。文字为白色，30 px、特粗、字距 1 px。
一组包含四个词：WEB DESIGN / BRANDING / MOTION / UI/UX，间隔 64 px，每个空隙有一个橙点（半径 6）。
每个循环（4.8 s）以恒定速度向左移动一组内容的宽度，此处约 881 px。先测量该组宽度，再按此宽度循环偏移，因此看不见接缝。
重复该组内容，直到填满视口宽度。

use.en: Use it to show service names, client logos or a tagline with energy.
use.zh-Hans: 用于充满活力地展示服务名称、客户标志或宣传语。

meaning.en: Background colours keep drifting and blending
meaning.zh-Hans: 背景颜色持续移动和交融

ask.en: Give the hero an animated gradient background: orange and blue slowly blending, one loop every 10 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 首屏用橙蓝缓慢交融的动态渐变背景，每 10 s 循环一次。

summary.en: Behind the headline, soft patches of orange, light orange, blue and light blue drift in circles and keep blending differently.
summary.zh-Hans: 标题背后，柔和的橙色、浅橙色、蓝色和浅蓝色色块绕圈漂移，不断以不同方式交融。

en: Base colour #FFF1EB, with four radial gradients on top (centre colour → transparent at the edge, each at 0.85 opacity).
Orange (radius 230), light orange #FFB08F (210), blue (240), light blue #9DB6FB (200).
Each centre travels an ellipse once per 4.8 s (x radii 70, 60, 80, 50; y radii 30, 40, 30, 35; start angles 0, 2.1, 4.2, 1.0 rad).
A white headline (34 px) and a button sit on top; only the gradient moves.
zh-Hans: 底色为 #FFF1EB，上方叠加四个径向渐变，均从中心颜色过渡到边缘透明，各自不透明度 0.85。
橙色半径 230，浅橙色 #FFB08F 半径 210，蓝色半径 240，浅蓝色 #9DB6FB 半径 200。
各中心每 4.8 s 沿椭圆运动一周；x 半径分别为 70、60、80、50，y 半径为 30、40、30、35，起始角为 0、2.1、4.2、1.0 rad。
白色标题（34 px）和按钮置于上方；只有渐变移动。

use.en: Use it to add movement and colour behind a hero or heading without using a photo.
use.zh-Hans: 无需照片，即可为首屏主视觉或标题背景增加动态与色彩。

meaning.en: Elements bob gently up and down
meaning.zh-Hans: 元素轻柔地上下浮动

ask.en: Give the phone image in the hero a floating animation: 8 px up and down, one bob every 2.4 s.
ask.zh-Hans: 给首屏的手机图加上悬浮动画：上下浮动 8 px，每 2.4 s 往返一次。

summary.en: Next to the headline, a phone, a heart badge and a rating chip each bob gently out of step, and the shadow under the phone grows and shrinks.
summary.zh-Hans: 标题旁的手机、爱心徽标和评分标签以不同节奏轻轻上下浮动，手机下方的阴影随之缩放。

en: Phone (92 × 132): y = −8·sin(2πt/2.4), one bob per 2.4 s; a sine slows at both ends.
Heart badge (radius 20): y = −6·sin(2πt/1.6 + 1.2). Rating chip (76 × 30): y = −6·sin(2πt/2.4 + 2.4).
Shadow under the phone (54 × 6 ellipse): size and opacity scale by (1 + y/40), so it shrinks and fades as the phone rises.
Both periods (2.4 s and 1.6 s) divide 4.8 s, so the loop has no seam.
zh-Hans: 手机为 92×132：y = −8·sin(2πt/2.4)，每 2.4 s 浮动一次；正弦曲线使两端减速。
手机下方阴影为 54×6 的椭圆，尺寸和不透明度均乘以 (1 + y/40)，因此手机上升时阴影缩小并变淡。
两个周期（2.4 s 和 1.6 s）都能整除 4.8 s，因此循环无缝衔接。

use.en: Use it to add quiet motion to product images, app mockups or decorative icons.
use.zh-Hans: 为产品图片、应用模型或装饰图标增添轻柔动态。

meaning.en: The light source sits behind the subject
meaning.zh-Hans: 光源位于主体后方

ask.en: Backlit portrait of a person in a meadow, the low sun right behind their head, glowing hair outline and soft haze.
ask.zh-Hans: 草地人像用逆光，低处太阳正对头后，发丝边缘发亮，带柔和薄雾。

summary.en: The sun moves from outside the frame to directly behind the person's head; a thin bright edge appears around the figure, a pale warm haze covers the frame and the side facing the camera darkens.
summary.zh-Hans: 太阳从画框外移到人物头部正后方；人物轮廓出现细亮边，整幅画面笼罩浅暖色薄雾，朝向镜头的一侧变暗。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). light is a flat amber #FFC75A shape, shadow a flat #33405A one
Sun: radius 20 px, from outside the frame (top left, x 40, y −40) to directly behind the head (x 270, y 56), with flat rings of 2.6× and 1.7× the radius (#FFE3A3 at 35% and 60%)
Outline: the figure is stroked with a 7 px line and then filled, leaving a 3.5 px bright edge outside it
Figure #4D5A75 → #33405A; sky #FAF9F7 → #FFF4DC; #FFE3A3 laid over the whole frame at 22%
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。亮部使用纯琥珀色 #FFC75A，阴影使用纯色 #33405A。
太阳半径 20 px，从画框外左上方 (x 40, y −40) 移至头部正后方 (x 270, y 56)；带有半径分别为太阳 2.6 倍和 1.7 倍的纯色光环，颜色 #FFE3A3，不透明度分别 35% 和 60%。
轮廓：先为人物描绘 7 px 线条，再填充人物，在轮廓外留下 3.5 px 的亮边。
人物 #4D5A75→#33405A；天空 #FAF9F7→#FFF4DC；整幅画面叠加不透明度 22% 的 #FFE3A3。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: For airy, glowing portraits or any image that should feel bathed in light.
use.zh-Hans: 用于通透发光的人像，或任何需要沐浴在光线中感觉的图像。

meaning.en: A light from behind that outlines the subject's edge
meaning.zh-Hans: 后侧光勾勒主体边缘

ask.en: Portrait on a black background with rim lights from both rear sides; the face stays dark and only the outline of the head and shoulders glows.
ask.zh-Hans: 黑色背景人像，两侧后方打轮廓光，脸保持暗，只让头肩轮廓发亮。

summary.en: The surroundings go dark and two lights behind the person, left and right, draw thin bright edges only along both sides of the head and shoulders; the plan at the bottom right shows where the two lights are.
summary.zh-Hans: 周围环境变暗，人物后方左右两盏灯仅在头部和肩部两侧勾勒细亮边；右下方平面图显示两盏灯的位置。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).
Background: light scene → dark scene (sky #2B2D33, ground #24252A); figure #4D5A75 → #1F2128
Bright edges: two copies of the figure in amber #FFC75A, shifted 3.5 px left and right and 2.5 px up, placed behind the dark figure (3.5 px wide edges)
Plan at the bottom right (66×66 px): lights at ±135° seen from above (behind, left and right); top-right readout "±135°"
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。
背景由明亮场景变为暗场景，天空 #2B2D33、地面 #24252A；人物 #4D5A75→#1F2128。
亮边：在深色人物后放置两个琥珀色 #FFC75A 的人物副本，分别左右偏移 3.5 px，同时上移 2.5 px，形成宽 3.5 px 的边缘。
右下角平面图 66×66 px：俯视下灯光位于 ±135°，即后方左右两侧；右上角读数为“±135°”。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To separate a person or product from a dark background and show its shape.
use.zh-Hans: 用于将人物或产品从暗背景中分离出来，突出形状。

meaning.en: The subject shows as a black shape against a bright sky
meaning.zh-Hans: 主体成为明亮背景前的深色轮廓

ask.en: Silhouette of a person jumping on a beach at sunset; expose for the sky so the person and the palm tree turn pure black.
ask.zh-Hans: 夕阳海滩上跳跃的人物剪影，按天空曝光，让人物和棕榈树变成纯黑。

summary.en: As the exposure is set for the bright evening sky, the person, buildings, lamp and tree turn into flat black shapes with no detail and only the sky stays bright.
summary.zh-Hans: 按明亮晚霞设定曝光后，人物、建筑、路灯和树木都变成没有细节的纯黑形状，只有天空仍然明亮。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).
Sky: #FAF9F7 → #FFEDC4 at the top and a #FFCF73 band near the horizon (y 92–150)
Everything but the sky becomes #2A2D36, the far hills #4A4546; the figure #22252D
Sun: radius 20 px at x 404, sinking from y 60 to y 128, half hidden by the hills
Top-right readout: ±0.0 EV → −2.0 EV
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。
天空：顶部 #FAF9F7→#FFEDC4，地平线附近 y 92–150 为 #FFCF73 色带。
除天空外的物体变为 #2A2D36，远山为 #4A4546，人物为 #22252D。
太阳半径 20 px，位于 x 404，从 y 60 降至 y 128，被山丘遮住一半。
右上角读数：±0.0 EV→−2.0 EV。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: When the shape and pose should carry the picture, against a sunset or a bright window.
use.zh-Hans: 用于日落或明亮窗户前，让形状与姿态成为画面重点。

meaning.en: Light from the side splits the face into lit and dark halves
meaning.zh-Hans: 侧面光让脸一半明亮、一半阴暗

ask.en: Portrait with split lighting: the light at 90° to the side, the face divided down the nose, the far half in shadow.
ask.zh-Hans: 人像采用分割光，灯在侧面 90°，以鼻梁为界，另一半脸处于阴影。

summary.en: The light swings from near the front (20°) to directly at the side (90°); the shadow on the head grows from a crescent to exactly half, splitting the face down the middle.
summary.zh-Hans: 灯光从近正面 20° 转向正侧面 90°；头部阴影从月牙形扩大到恰好一半，将面部沿中央分开。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
Light: from the left of the frame, angle 20° → 90° (plan at the bottom right, top-right readout "90° · ↑0°")
Head: right of x = 270 + cos(angle)·√(29² − dy²) is shadow #33405A, left is light #FFC75A; at 90° the edge is the straight centre line
Body (half-width 56 px): right of x = 270 + cos(angle)·56 is shadow, a strip on the left edge is lit
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。背景转为较暗场景，天空 #E7E5E1。
光源从画面左侧照来，角度 20°→90°；右下角显示平面图，右上角读数“90° · ↑0°”。
头部：x = 270 + cos(angle)·√(29² − dy²) 右侧为阴影 #33405A，左侧为亮部 #FFC75A；90° 时边界为笔直的中线。
身体半宽 56 px：x = 270 + cos(angle)·56 右侧为阴影，左侧边缘的一条窄带受光。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: For dramatic, tense or moody portraits.
use.zh-Hans: 用于充满戏剧性、紧张感或情绪氛围的人像。

meaning.en: High side light that leaves a lit triangle on the shadow cheek
meaning.zh-Hans: 侧上方光在背光脸颊留下亮三角

ask.en: Portrait of an old man in Rembrandt lighting: light from 45° to the side and above, leaving a small triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek.
ask.zh-Hans: 老人肖像用伦勃朗光，从侧上方 45° 打光，背光侧脸颊留一小块三角亮区。

summary.en: A light 45° to the side and 45° up comes on; the right side of the face falls into shadow except for a small inverted triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek.
summary.zh-Hans: 侧上方各 45° 的光源亮起；脸部右侧进入阴影，只有阴影侧脸颊保留一个小的倒三角亮区。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
Head: right of x = 270 + 0.04·29 is shadow #33405A, left is light #FFC75A
Light triangle: (x 270+0.24R, y 78−0.12R), (x 270+0.7R, y 78−0.12R), (x 270+0.24R, y 78+0.5R) with R = 29 (about 13 px wide, 18 px tall), separated from the lit side by a shadow strip about 6 px wide
Body: lit left of centre −0.45×56 px, shadow right of +0.3×56 px; plan shows the light at 45°, top-right readout "45° · ↑45°"
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。背景转为较暗场景，天空 #E7E5E1。
头部：x = 270 + 0.04·29 右侧为阴影 #33405A，左侧为亮部 #FFC75A。
身体：中心 −0.45×56 px 左侧受光，+0.3×56 px 右侧为阴影；平面图显示光源位于 45°，右上角读数“45° · ↑45°”。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: For portraits with a painterly, sculpted, classic look.
use.zh-Hans: 用于具有绘画感、立体雕塑感与古典气质的人像。

meaning.en: High frontal light that casts a butterfly shadow under the nose
meaning.zh-Hans: 正面高位光在鼻下形成蝶形阴影

ask.en: Beauty portrait with butterfly lighting: light straight in front and 45° above, a small butterfly-shaped shadow under the nose.
ask.zh-Hans: 美妆人像用蝴蝶光：灯在正前方、高于面部约 45°，鼻下留出小小的蝶形阴影。

summary.en: A light in front of the face and high above comes on; the face lights evenly on both sides and only a small symmetrical shadow falls under the chin.
summary.zh-Hans: 位于面部正前方高处的光源亮起；脸部两侧均匀受光，只有下巴下方出现一个小而对称的阴影。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
Head: entirely lit #FFC75A (no shadow side)
Shadow under the chin: an ellipse centred at y 78+1.06R, 0.72R wide and 0.38R tall (R = 29, about 21×11 px), colour #33405A
Body: lit within ±0.8×56 px of the centre, thin outer strips keep the base colour; plan shows the light on the camera side (0°), top-right readout "0° · ↑45°"
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。背景转为较暗场景，天空 #E7E5E1。
头部全部受光，颜色 #FFC75A，没有阴影侧。
身体：中心两侧 ±0.8×56 px 内受光，外缘窄条保留底色；平面图显示光源位于镜头侧 0°，右上角读数“0° · ↑45°”。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: For beauty and fashion portraits that flatter the face.
use.zh-Hans: 用于能美化面部的美容和时尚人像。

meaning.en: The low, warm light just after sunrise or before sunset
meaning.zh-Hans: 日出后或日落前的低角度暖光

ask.en: A person in a field at golden hour: the sun near the horizon, long shadows, everything warm orange.
ask.zh-Hans: 黄金时刻的田野人物，太阳接近地平线，长阴影，整体暖橙色。

summary.en: The sun drops to just above the horizon; sky and ground turn orange, the left side of the person lights up and the shadows of the lamp and tree stretch far to the right.
summary.zh-Hans: 太阳降到地平线上方，天空和地面变为橙色，人物左侧被照亮，路灯和树木的阴影向右拉长。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).
Sun: radius 18 px, from (x 110, y −30) to (x 96, y 136), half hidden by the hills
Colour: sky #FAF9F7 → #FFE8BC at the top and #FFCF80 near the horizon, ground #F1F0EE → #F6DDB0; light on the figure #FFB547, shadow #3E3650
Head: light from the left at about 66°, shadow right of the edge; body lit on the left, shadow on the right
Shadows: from the foot of the lamp and tree to the right, length 0 → 150 px (#DDAA6E); top-right time 12:00 → 17:40
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。
太阳半径 18 px，从 (x 110, y −30) 移至 (x 96, y 136)，被山丘遮住一半。
颜色：天空顶部 #FAF9F7→#FFE8BC，地平线附近为 #FFCF80；地面 #F1F0EE→#F6DDB0；人物亮部 #FFB547，阴影 #3E3650。
头部：光从左侧约 66° 照来，边界右侧为阴影；身体左侧受光，右侧为阴影。
阴影从路灯和树木底部向右延伸，长度 0→150 px，颜色 #DDAA6E；右上角时间 12:00→17:40。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: For warm, nostalgic, gentle-feeling images.
use.zh-Hans: 用于温暖、怀旧、柔和的图像。

meaning.en: The time after sunset or before sunrise when the sky turns deep blue
meaning.zh-Hans: 日落后或日出前的深蓝天空时段

ask.en: Harbour city at blue hour: deep blue sky, warm windows and streetlights reflected in the water.
ask.zh-Hans: 蓝调时刻的港口城市，深蓝天空，暖窗灯和路灯倒映水面。

summary.en: Once the sun has set, the sky turns two bands of deep blue, the windows and street lamp come on in amber and the person becomes a dark blue shape.
summary.zh-Hans: 日落后，天空变成两层深蓝色，窗户和路灯亮起琥珀光，人物变为深蓝色形状。

en: Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair).
Sun: radius 18 px at x 120, sinking from y 40 to y 190 while the effect reaches 70%, fading out between 40% and 80%
Colour: sky #2C3B5E at the top and #4A6191 near the horizon, ground #283452, buildings #34446B, figure #1C2439
Lights: one window in three and the lamp bulb turn #FFC75A; flat rings of 13 px and 8 px (#FFE3A3 at 35% and 60%) around the bulb
Top-right time 12:00 → 18:35
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 1：地平线位于 y 150，前方为肩部以上的人物（头部中心 x 270、y 78，半径 29 px，无面部或头发）。
太阳半径 18 px、x 120，在效果强度达到 70% 前从 y 40 降至 y 190，并在强度 40%–80% 期间淡出。
灯光：每三个窗户中一个和路灯灯泡变为 #FFC75A；灯泡周围有半径 13 px 和 8 px 的纯色光环，颜色 #FFE3A3，不透明度分别 35% 和 60%。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: For city and night scenes that need both a blue sky and glowing lights.
use.zh-Hans: 用于同时需要蓝色天空和发光灯饰的城市与夜景。

meaning.en: Out-of-focus points of light melt into soft discs
meaning.zh-Hans: 失焦光点化为柔和光斑

ask.en: Person in a city at night with big round bokeh from the street lights behind; f/1.4, focus on the person.
ask.zh-Hans: 夜间城市人像，人物清晰，身后街灯形成大圆散景，光圈 f/1.4。

summary.en: As the aperture opens, the in-focus person stays sharp, the buildings behind soften and the street lamps and distant lights spread into large, pale discs.
summary.zh-Hans: 光圈打开时，焦点上的人物保持清晰，背后建筑变柔，路灯和远处灯光扩散成大而浅的圆斑。

en: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
Background blur (everything but the person): 0 → 6 px
Lights: the three lamps (size 1.25) and 12 more spaced 45 px apart (y 44–114, size 0.6–1.2, fixed seed); disc radius = (2.4 + 15 × effect) × size
Discs: opacity 100% → 55%, lamps amber #FFC75A, distant lights #FFE3A3, with a 1.2 px amber rim
The person stays sharp; top-right aperture f/16 → f/1.4 (8 stops)
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 2：街角；y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯（x 114、292、494）；人物站在左前方，双脚位于 x 176、y 200，身高 124 px。背景转为较暗场景，天空 #E7E5E1。
背景模糊度（人物以外的全部内容）0→6 px。
灯光：三盏路灯尺寸系数 1.25，另有 12 个间隔 45 px 的光点，y 44–114、尺寸系数 0.6–1.2，随机种子固定；圆斑半径 = (2.4 + 15 × 效果强度) × 尺寸系数。
圆斑不透明度 100%→55%；路灯为琥珀色 #FFC75A，远处灯光为 #FFE3A3，带 1.2 px 琥珀色边缘。
人物保持清晰；右上角光圈 f/16→f/1.4，共 8 档。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To lift a person or product off the background and add a soft, festive night mood.
use.zh-Hans: 用于突出人物或产品，使其脱离背景，并增加柔和、节庆般的夜间氛围。

meaning.en: Blur top and bottom so a real scene looks like a miniature
meaning.zh-Hans: 通过选择性模糊让实景像微缩模型

ask.en: High-angle view of a town with a tilt-shift look: a narrow sharp band across the middle, strong blur above and below, boosted colour, like a miniature model.
ask.zh-Hans: 高角度城镇图做移轴效果，仅中间窄带清晰，上下强模糊，颜色鲜艳，像微缩模型。

summary.en: The top and bottom bands of the street blur while only the middle band with the road, the car and the small people stays in focus, so the street looks like a model.
summary.zh-Hans: 街景顶部和底部变模糊，只有道路、汽车和小人物所在的中间区域保持清晰，使街道像一座模型。

en: The street corner (buildings, trees and lamps behind a road at y 132–162) without the large person; four small people 23–26 px tall stand on the pavement (feet at y 172); the car drives from x −60 to 600 every 5 s
Focus band: y 66–176 stays sharp
Blur: y 0–42 and y 190–208 go 0 → 7 px; y 42–66 and y 176–190 go 0 → 3 px
Dashed lines on the band edges (6 px dash, 5 px gap, #8E8E93 at 75%)
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 街角场景：y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯，没有大人物；四个身高 23–26 px 的小人物站在人行道上，双脚 y 172；汽车每 5 s 从 x −60 行驶至 600。
对焦带：y 66–176 保持清晰。
对焦带边缘有虚线，每段长 6 px、间隙 5 px，颜色 #8E8E93、不透明度 75%。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To make a city or event look like a toy model world.
use.zh-Hans: 用于将城市或活动呈现为玩具模型世界。

meaning.en: Keep the shutter open long so moving lights become lines
meaning.zh-Hans: 延长快门时间，让移动光源留下轨迹

ask.en: Night road as a long exposure, 8-second shutter: the cars disappear and only their headlights and tail lights remain as white and red trails.
ask.zh-Hans: 夜间道路用 8 s 长曝光，让车辆消失，只留白色车头灯与红色尾灯轨迹。

summary.en: The street turns to night; the moving car fades to almost nothing, a red tail-light line stretches out behind it and white and amber lines run along the opposite lane.
summary.zh-Hans: 街道变为夜景；行驶的汽车几乎隐去，红色尾灯光线在车后拉长，对向车道出现白色与琥珀色线条。

en: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall). colours go to night (sky #2C3B5E, one window in three #FFC75A)
Car: x −60 → 600 every 5 s; body opacity 100% → 10%
Tail-light line: from x −60 to the car: #FF5B4D 2.6 px at y 145 and #FF8A6E 1.4 px at y 149
Opposite lane: full-width lines #FFE9B8 2.6 px at y 135, #FFC75A 1.6 px at y 138.5 and #FFE9B8 1.2 px at y 141.5 (they fade in with the effect)
Top-right shutter speed 1/250 → 8″
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 2：街角；y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯（x 114、292、494）；人物站在左前方，双脚位于 x 176、y 200，身高 124 px。配色转为夜景，天空 #2C3B5E，每三个窗户中一个为 #FFC75A。
汽车每 5 s 从 x −60→600；车身不透明度 100%→10%。
尾灯线从 x −60 延伸到汽车位置：y 145 处为 #FF5B4D、粗 2.6 px，y 149 处为 #FF8A6E、粗 1.4 px。
对向车道的线条横贯全宽：y 135 处 #FFE9B8、粗 2.6 px；y 138.5 处 #FFC75A、粗 1.6 px；y 141.5 处 #FFE9B8、粗 1.2 px；随效果淡入。
右上角快门速度 1/250→8″。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To show traffic flow, or silky water and clouds, in a single still.
use.zh-Hans: 用于在单张静态图中表现车流，或丝绸般的流水与云彩。

meaning.en: Follow a moving subject so only the background streaks
meaning.zh-Hans: 跟随运动主体，使背景产生拖影

ask.en: Panning shot of a red car driving past, 1/15 s shutter: the car sharp, the trees and buildings behind streaked sideways.
ask.zh-Hans: 用 1/15 s 快门追拍驶过的红车，让车身清晰，身后树木建筑横向拖影。

summary.en: The camera follows the moving car: the car stays sharp in the middle of the frame while only the buildings, trees and lamps behind it streak sideways.
summary.zh-Hans: 镜头跟随行驶的汽车；汽车在画面中央保持清晰，只有后方建筑、树木和路灯横向拖成条纹。

en: Street corner: buildings, trees and lamps behind a road at y 132–162 (no large person in front)
Car: without the effect it drives from x −80 to 620 in 5 s; with it, it stays at x 270 ±10 px
Streak: the background is drawn 12 times spread over 46 px sideways and averaged (spread 0 → 46 px)
Wheels: a spoke line turns 12 times per 5 s
Top-right shutter speed 1/1000 → 1/15
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 街角：y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯，前方没有大人物。
汽车：无效果时在 5 s 内从 x −80 行驶至 620；有效果时保持在 x 270 ±10 px。
拖影：将背景横向分布绘制 12 次并取平均，分布范围从 0→46 px。
车轮：辐条线每 5 s 转动 12 圈。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To show the speed of a car, bike or runner in a still photo.
use.zh-Hans: 用于在静态照片中表现汽车、自行车或跑者的速度。

meaning.en: Rings and spots of light from a bright source in the lens
meaning.zh-Hans: 强光在镜头内产生光环和光斑

ask.en: Mountain landscape with the sun in frame and lens flare: coloured ghosts lined up from the sun through the centre to the opposite side.
ask.zh-Hans: 山景中太阳入画，彩色眩光沿太阳经过画面中心延伸至对侧。

summary.en: As the sun comes out from behind a building, rays appear around it and a line of light dots, hexagons and a ring runs from the sun through the centre of the frame to the opposite side.
summary.zh-Hans: 太阳从建筑后露出时，周围出现光芒；光点、六边形和光环沿太阳穿过画面中心的直线延伸至另一侧。

en: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).
Sun: radius 13 px, from behind a building (x 428, y 74) to open sky (x 474, y 30)
Rays: 8, from 17 px out from the centre of the sun to 26 px or 44 px, alternating (9 px and 27 px long; amber, 1.6 px, 75%)

Flare: on the line from the sun through the centre at t = 0.45, 0.8, 1.15, 1.45, 1.75 and 2.0 (t = 1 is the centre): a 7 px circle, a 13 px hexagon, a 5 px circle, a 22 px hexagon, a 9 px circle and a 30 px ring (3 px line)
Colours amber #FFC75A and #FFE3A3 at 40–70% × the effect
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 2：街角；y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯（x 114、292、494）；人物站在左前方，双脚位于 x 176、y 200，身高 124 px。
太阳半径 13 px，从建筑后 (x 428, y 74) 移至开阔天空 (x 474, y 30)。
光芒 8 条，从距太阳中心 17 px 处向外延伸，终点交替为 26 px 或 44 px，即长度 9 px 和 27 px；琥珀色、粗 1.6 px、不透明度 75%。
眩光位于太阳穿过画面中心的直线上，t = 0.45、0.8、1.15、1.45、1.75、2.0，t = 1 为中心；依次是 7 px 圆、13 px 六边形、5 px 圆、22 px 六边形、9 px 圆和 30 px 光环（线宽 3 px）。
颜色为琥珀色 #FFC75A 和 #FFE3A3，不透明度为 40%–70% × 效果强度。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To add glare, summer sunshine or a cinematic light feel.
use.zh-Hans: 用于增加眩光、夏日阳光或电影般的光感。

meaning.en: Ultra-wide lens that bulges the centre and bends straight lines
meaning.zh-Hans: 超广角使中心鼓起、直线弯曲

ask.en: City street through a fisheye lens, 180° view, the building edges bowing outward.
ask.zh-Hans: 城市街道用 180° 鱼眼视角，建筑边缘向外弯曲。

summary.en: The middle of the street scene bulges out; the vertical lines of the buildings and the lines of the road bow outward while the corners stay where they are.
summary.zh-Hans: 街景中央向外鼓起，建筑竖线和道路线条向外弯曲，四角保持原位。

en: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).
Warp: a point at distance d from the centre moves to g = (1 + k) / (1 + k·d²/R²) times that distance, R = distance from the centre to a corner (289 px)
k: 0 → 1.25; the centre is magnified 2.25×, the corners do not move
Every outline is cut every 6 px before warping, so straight lines become curves
Top-right focal length 24mm → 8mm
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 2：街角；y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯（x 114、292、494）；人物站在左前方，双脚位于 x 176、y 200，身高 124 px。
畸变：距中心为 d 的点，其距离乘以 g = (1 + k) / (1 + k·d²/R²)，其中 R 为中心至角落的距离，289 px。
k 从 0→1.25；中央放大 2.25 倍，四角不移动。
所有轮廓在畸变前每 6 px 分段，使直线变成曲线。
右上角焦距 24mm→8mm。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: For bold, playful or peephole-like views (skateboarding, music videos).
use.zh-Hans: 用于大胆、活泼或猫眼般的视角，例如滑板和音乐视频。

meaning.en: Red and blue-violet colour fringes along high-contrast edges
meaning.zh-Hans: 高反差边缘出现不同颜色的色边

ask.en: Black branches against a white sky with slight chromatic aberration: red and blue-violet fringes on the edges, stronger toward the corners.
ask.zh-Hans: 给白色天空前的黑色树枝加上轻微色差，边缘出现红色与蓝紫色的色边，越靠近画面边缘越明显。

summary.en: The street scene is split into red, green and blue and the three are laid back together at slightly different sizes, so red and cyan fringes appear on the edges of the person, buildings and lamps, larger towards the sides.
summary.zh-Hans: 街景分解为红、绿、蓝三层，以略有不同的尺寸叠回，人物、建筑和路灯边缘出现红色与青色彩边，越靠两侧越明显。

en: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).
Split: the image is multiplied by red #FF0000, green #00FF00 and blue #0000FF into three copies and added back together over black
Scale about the centre: red 1 + 2s, green 1 + s, blue 1, with s = 0 → 0.02
Offset: red and blue end up about 11 px apart at the left and right edges, 0 at the centre
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 2：街角；y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯（x 114、292、494）；人物站在左前方，双脚位于 x 176、y 200，身高 124 px。
分色：图像分别与红色 #FF0000、绿色 #00FF00、蓝色 #0000FF 相乘生成三个副本，再在黑色底上相加合成。
以中心缩放：红色 1 + 2s，绿色 1 + s，蓝色 1，其中 s = 0→0.02。
偏移：左右边缘处红蓝两层最终相距约 11 px，中央为 0。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To add an imperfect old-lens, VHS or glitch feel.
use.zh-Hans: 用于增加不完美的老镜头、VHS 或故障感。

meaning.en: The corners darken and draw the eye to the centre
meaning.zh-Hans: 画面四角变暗，视线集中到中央

ask.en: Beach photo with a strong vignette: the corners darken gradually so the eye goes to the person in the middle.
ask.zh-Hans: 海滩照片加明显暗角，四角逐渐变暗，将视线引向中央人物。

summary.en: The frame darkens smoothly from the corners while the person and the road in the middle stay bright.
summary.zh-Hans: 画面从四角平滑变暗，中央的人物和道路保持明亮。

en: Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall).
Shape: an ellipse centred on the frame (vertical radius = horizontal × 208/539 × 1.35)
Clear out to 45% of the 334 px horizontal radius, then rgb(32,35,43) rising from 0% to 70% towards the edge
Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
zh-Hans: 场景 2：街角；y 132–162 的道路后方有建筑、树木和路灯（x 114、292、494）；人物站在左前方，双脚位于 x 176、y 200，身高 124 px。
形状：以画面中心为中心的椭圆，垂直半径 = 水平半径 × 208/539 × 1.35。
水平半径为 334 px，其 45% 以内完全透明；之后 rgb(32,35,43) 的不透明度向边缘从 0% 增至 70%。
时序：效果在 0.4–1.4 s 渐入，保持到 4.0 s，并在 4.8 s 前消失；每轮 5 s，使用 cubic ease-in-out，约为 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。

use.en: To focus attention on the subject, or to suggest an old lens.
use.zh-Hans: 用于将注意力集中在主体，或营造老镜头感。

meaning.en: A bright, white-toned image with very light shadows
meaning.zh-Hans: 整体明亮、接近白色且阴影很浅

ask.en: High-key still life of a cup and a bottle on a white table: pure white background, very faint shadows, only light tones.
ask.zh-Hans: 白桌上的杯瓶静物用高调，纯白背景、极浅阴影，只保留浅色调。

summary.en: The landscape and the person turn to light, near-white colours with very faint shadows, and the hump of the histogram at the bottom right moves to the right end.
summary.zh-Hans: 风景与人物变为接近白色的浅色，阴影非常微弱；右下角直方图的峰值移向最右端。

en: Scene 3: a bust on the left (head centre x 140, y 82, radius 28 px) and hills, a house, trees and the sun (x 432, y 54, radius 15 px) on the right.
Colour: sky #FAF9F7 → #FFFFFF, hills #EAEDF1 → #F5F6F8, figure #4D5A75 → #B9C0CE, shadow #33405A → #A6AEBF, sun #F5A524 → #FFD889
Histogram (96×46 px, 20 bars): peak centre 0.56 → 0.85, width 0.2 → 0.09
