use.zh-Hans: 用于点赞、收藏或保存按钮，以清晰愉悦的反馈确认点击。

meaning.en: A looping cue that invites you to scroll down
meaning.zh-Hans: 持续循环、引导向下滚动的动画

ask.en: Add a scroll-down cue below the hero: a dot inside a mouse outline slides down and fades about every 1.5 s, on repeat.
ask.zh-Hans: 在首屏下方加入向下滚动提示：鼠标轮廓内的小圆点约每 1.5 s 向下移动并消失，循环播放。

summary.en: Below the hero, the word "SCROLL", a dot inside a mouse outline and arrows on either side keep repeating a downward motion.
summary.zh-Hans: 首屏下方的 SCROLL、鼠标轮廓内的小点，以及两侧箭头，持续重复向下运动。

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Centered below the hero: "SCROLL" (11 px, 3 px letter spacing) and a mouse outline (24 × 38, radius 12, line width 2.2). One beat takes 1.57 s (three per 4.7 s, six per 9.4 s pack cycle).
The orange dot inside (5 × 9) drops 14 px over the first 70% of the beat (quadratic ease-in-out), fades out between 45% and 75%, and reappears at the top on the next beat.
40 px to each side, two down-chevrons (line width 2.5) per side, half a beat apart, drift 24 px downward; their opacity follows a sine, 0 → 0.8 → 0.
zh-Hans: 视口 511 × 168。首屏下方居中放置 SCROLL（字号 11 px，字距 3 px）及鼠标轮廓（24 × 38，圆角半径 12，线宽 2.2）。每拍 1.57 s（每 4.7 s 三拍，每 9.4 s 效果包周期六拍）。
内部橙色点尺寸 5 × 9，在每拍前 70% 时间内下移 14 px（二次缓入缓出），在 45%–75% 之间淡出，并于下一拍在顶部重新出现。
左右各 40 px 处，每侧两个向下折线箭头（线宽 2.5），相隔半拍，向下漂移 24 px；不透明度按正弦变化，0→0.8→0。

use.en: Use it when the hero fills the screen and people need a hint that the page goes on below.
use.zh-Hans: 用于占满屏幕的首屏，提示用户下方还有内容。

meaning.en: A video plays behind the hero section
meaning.zh-Hans: 首屏背景中播放视频

ask.en: Give the hero a background video: muted and looping, with a dark gradient on the left so the headline stays readable.
ask.zh-Hans: 首屏使用背景视频：静音循环播放，左侧叠加深色渐变，保证标题清晰可读。

summary.en: In the hero background, clouds and waves keep moving, while the headline and button sit still on top.
summary.zh-Hans: 首屏背景中的云与波浪持续移动，前景标题和按钮保持静止。

en: A 511 × 168 viewport. Background footage (sky, clouds, mountains, sea) fills the hero, with a still headline (28 px, white) and button on top. The footage loops every 4.7 s (twice per 9.4 s pack cycle).
Clouds: the far layer repeats every 170 px and moves 170 px right per 4.7 s (about 36 px/s); the near layer repeats every 340 px and moves 340 px per 4.7 s (about 72 px/s). The mountains stay still.

Sea: three waves (y = 118, 130, 146; amplitude 2.5–3 px; wavelength 90, 60, 120 px); only the middle one runs the other way and moves two wavelengths per 4.7 s (the other two move one wavelength to the right).
For legibility, a 12% navy layer covers the footage, a gradient darkens the left 300 px (opacity 0.45 → 0), and the headline has a shadow (10 px blur).
A playing badge (pause, muted) sits at the bottom right. On a real site the video uses autoplay, muted, loop and playsinline.
zh-Hans: 视口 511 × 168。背景视频包含天空、云、山和海，铺满首屏，上方叠加静止的白色标题（28 px）和按钮。视频每 4.7 s 循环（每个 9.4 s 的效果包周期两次）。
云：远层每 170 px 重复，每 4.7 s 向右移动 170 px（约 36 px/s）；近层每 340 px 重复，每 4.7 s 移动 340 px（约 72 px/s）。山保持静止。
海：三层波浪，y = 118、130、146，振幅 2.5–3 px，波长分别 90、60、120 px；仅中层反向运动，每 4.7 s 移动两个波长，其余两层向右移动一个波长。
为保证可读性，视频上叠加 12% 藏青色覆盖层，左侧 300 px 用渐变压暗（不透明度 0.45→0），标题带模糊 10 px 的阴影。
右下角显示播放状态标记（暂停、静音）。真实网站的视频使用 autoplay、muted、loop 和 playsinline。

use.en: Use it on hero sections for travel, hotels, restaurants or recruiting, where atmosphere and motion say more than one photo.
use.zh-Hans: 用于旅游、酒店、餐饮或招聘首屏，以氛围和动态传递单张照片难以表达的感受。

meaning.en: Move the whole camera straight up or down
meaning.zh-Hans: 相机整体垂直上下平移

ask.en: Pedestal up from eye level to about 3 meters, keeping the camera pointed straight ahead.
ask.zh-Hans: 保持镜头朝向不变，用垂直升降镜头从眼睛高度直线上升到约 3 m。

summary.en: The camera moves straight up without changing its direction; the horizon stays centred while the person and buildings slide down.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机方向不变地垂直升高，地平线保持居中，人物和建筑向下滑动。

en: Camera: moves straight up from 1.0 m to 3.2 m; direction (yaw, pitch) and focal length (330 px) stay fixed
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead and slides down the frame, leaving at the bottom feet first; a tower stands 3.5 m right, 26 m away
Because the pitch does not change, the horizon stays at the centre of the frame (#031 Crane up tilts down while rising)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the height (↕ 1.0m → ↕ 3.2m)
zh-Hans: 相机：从 1.0 m 垂直上升至 3.2 m；方向（偏航、俯仰）和焦距（330 px）保持固定。
时间：0.5–3.4 s（2.9 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
主体：人物站在前方 7 m 处保持静止，在画面中向下滑动，双脚先从底部离开；塔楼位于右侧 3.5 m、远处 26 m。
由于俯仰角不变，地平线始终位于画面中央（#031 Crane up 在升高时向下俯拍）。
返回：3.4–4.2 s 保持，最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点，一轮 4.7 s。
右上角显示高度：↕ 1.0m→↕ 3.2m。

use.en: To show a shelf or a building from bottom to top smoothly, or to change the eye level without tilting.
use.zh-Hans: 用于平滑地从下往上展示货架或建筑，或在不俯仰相机的情况下改变视点高度。

meaning.en: Roll the camera a full turn on its axis
meaning.zh-Hans: 相机绕镜头光轴旋转一整圈

ask.en: Barrel roll the drone shot through one full rotation over 3 seconds.
ask.zh-Hans: 让无人机画面用横滚镜头旋转一整圈，用时 3 s。

summary.en: The camera rolls a full turn around its lens axis; the horizon goes all the way round and comes back level.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机绕镜头轴完整滚转一圈，地平线旋转整周后重新恢复水平。

en: Camera: position fixed (height 1.5 m); roll only, 0 → 2π rad (360°); the whole picture turns around the frame centre
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.6 s (3.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 7 m ahead; horizon, buildings and person all turn by the same angle, and white shows in the corners while turning
Hold: 3.6–4.2 s. After a full turn the picture equals the start, so the final 0.5 s cross-fade is invisible (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the angle (↻ 0° → ↻ 360°)
zh-Hans: 相机：位置固定，高度 1.5 m，仅滚转，角度 0→2π rad（360°）；整幅画面绕中心旋转。
时间：0.5–3.6 s（3.1 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
主体：人物静止站在前方 7 m；地平线、建筑与人物均旋转相同角度，旋转时四角露出白色。
3.6–4.2 s 保持。旋转整圈后与起始画面一致，因此最后 0.5 s 的交叉淡化不可见，一轮 4.7 s。

use.en: For aerial or drone footage that needs energy, or to show dizziness and confusion.
use.zh-Hans: 用于需要动感的航拍或无人机画面，也可表现眩晕和混乱。

meaning.en: A time-lapse shot while the camera travels
meaning.zh-Hans: 相机边移动边拍的延时摄影

ask.en: Hyperlapse walking from the station to the park, clouds streaming and people in fast forward.
ask.zh-Hans: 拍一段从车站走到公园的移动延时：云朵流动，行人像快进一样移动。

summary.en: The camera travels forward along a street while the sun, clouds and passers-by run in fast forward: a time-lapse that moves.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机沿街道前进，太阳、云和行人同时快速推进，形成移动中的延时摄影。

en: Camera: moves forward 0 m → 22 m (height 1.6 m, pitch +0.05 rad) while the sun, clouds and figures fast-forward through 12 hours (#039 Time-lapse keeps the camera still)
Timing: 0.4 s to 4.1 s (3.7 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Street: 12 buildings at x = ±7.5 m (5–55 m deep, 8–16 m tall) approach the camera and leave the frame

Sun: travels left to right along an arc, angle -1.25 rad → +1.25 rad, always 170 m ahead of the camera; three clouds drift 140 m right in total, wrapping every 80 m; six small figures cross an 11 m wide street
Building shadows fall away from the sun and swing as it moves (translucent grey); the mountains move with the camera so they keep their size
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the clock and the distance travelled (06:00 · 0m → 18:00 · 22m)
zh-Hans: 相机：向前移动 0→22 m，高度 1.6 m，俯仰角 +0.05 rad；太阳、云与人物快进 12 小时（#039 Time-lapse 的相机保持静止）。
时间：0.4–4.1 s（3.7 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
街道：12 栋建筑位于 x = ±7.5 m，纵深 5–55 m，高 8–16 m，逐渐靠近相机并离开画面。
太阳：沿弧线从左至右运行，角度 −1.25→+1.25 rad，始终位于相机前方 170 m；三朵云累计向右漂移 140 m，每 80 m 循环；六个小人物横穿 11 m 宽的街道。
建筑阴影为半透明灰色，背向太阳投射并随太阳移动而转动；山随相机移动，因此大小保持不变。
返回：最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点；右上角显示时间与行进距离：06:00 · 0m→18:00 · 22m。

use.en: To cover a long distance and a long stretch of time in one sweep through a city or a building.
use.zh-Hans: 用于一次穿行城市或建筑的镜头中，同时压缩长距离和长时间。

meaning.en: One continuous shot with no cuts
meaning.zh-Hans: 不切换，一个镜头连续拍到底

ask.en: Shoot from the preparation to the departure as one long take, following the person without a cut.
ask.zh-Hans: 从准备到出发用一个长镜头拍完，跟着人物，中间不切镜头。

summary.en: One continuous shot follows a walking person with no cut; the bar at the bottom stays a single unbroken strip.
summary.zh-Hans: 一个连续镜头跟随行走的人物，全程不切换；底部时间条始终连续不断。

en: Join: none; for 4.2 s one shot keeps following the person (#041 Jump cut splits it into five)
Subject: a person walks at constant speed from front left (x = -3.4 m, 5.2 m deep) to back right (x = 2.8 m, 9.6 m deep); legs and arms swing by sin(t×7)×0.42 rad
Camera: trucks right 0 m → 1.4 m after the person while turning, yaw = atan2(person x - camera x, depth)×0.8; height 1.4 m
Bottom strip: one blue bar labelled "One take · no cuts" (one shot, no cut) with a playhead, showing there is no break
Return: stops at 4.2 s, then cross-fades back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
Top-right readout shows the elapsed time (NO CUT 0.0s → 4.2s)
zh-Hans: 衔接：无；一个镜头持续跟随人物 4.2 s（#041 Jump cut 会将其分成五段）。
主体：人物以恒速从左前方（x = −3.4 m，纵深 5.2 m）走向右后方（x = 2.8 m，纵深 9.6 m）；四肢按 sin(t×7)×0.42 rad 摆动。
相机：跟随人物向右横移 0→1.4 m，同时转动，偏航角 = atan2(person x - camera x, depth)×0.8；高度 1.4 m。
底部条带：一整条蓝色条，标注 一镜到底 · 无剪切（单镜头、无剪切），并带播放头，表明全程没有中断。
返回：4.2 s 停止，最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点，一轮 4.7 s。
右上角显示已过时间：NO CUT 0.0s→4.2s。

use.en: To keep tension and presence unbroken, or to show a sequence of movement as one flow.
use.zh-Hans: 用于持续保持紧张感和临场感，或将连续动作呈现为完整流动过程。

meaning.en: Smooth, floating movement with no shake
meaning.zh-Hans: 消除抖动，平稳流畅地移动

ask.en: Follow the person down the corridor with a Steadicam: smooth, no shake.
ask.zh-Hans: 用斯坦尼康跟拍走廊里人物的背后，平稳无晃动。

summary.en: The camera glides forward after a walking person with only a slow, gentle sway and no jitter, unlike handheld.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机平滑前进，跟随行走的人物，仅有缓慢轻柔的摆动，没有手持摄影的抖动。

en: Camera: moves forward at a constant 1.7 m/s (8 m per 4.7 s); height 1.45 m, pitch -0.02 rad; no easing
Sway: height ±3.5 cm (2 cycles per 4.7 s), sideways ±5 cm (1 cycle), yaw ±0.012 rad, roll ±0.006 rad, all sine waves with integer periods, slow and wide (#034 Handheld is fast and irregular)
Subject: a person walks 5 m ahead of the camera at the same speed; legs and arms take 5 strides per 4.7 s
Trees: 3.6 m tall at x = -5 m and 3.2 m tall at x = +5 m, every 8 m (the two rows offset by 4 m); the mountains and sun move with the camera
8 m is a multiple of the grid (2 m) and tree (8 m) spacing, so it loops seamlessly every 4.7 s; top-right readout shows "STEADICAM"
zh-Hans: 相机：以 1.7 m/s 恒速前进（每 4.7 s 为 8 m），高度 1.45 m，俯仰角 −0.02 rad，不使用缓动。
摆动：高度 ±3.5 cm（每 4.7 s 两次），横向 ±5 cm（一次），偏航 ±0.012 rad，滚转 ±0.006 rad；均为整数周期的正弦波，缓慢而舒展（#034 Handheld 则快速且不规则）。
主体：人物始终在相机前方 5 m，以相同速度行走；四肢每 4.7 s 完成五次步伐摆动。
树木：x = −5 m 处高 3.6 m，x = +5 m 处高 3.2 m，每 8 m 一棵，两排错开 4 m；山与太阳随相机移动。
8 m 是网格间距 2 m 和树木间距 8 m 的整数倍，因此每 4.7 s 无缝循环；右上角显示 STEADICAM。

use.en: To make a walking move look smooth and cinematic.
use.zh-Hans: 让跟随步行的镜头呈现平稳的电影感。

meaning.en: Follow behind the subject as they move
meaning.zh-Hans: 跟在主体身后移动

ask.en: Follow shot behind the person walking through the woods, trailing a little behind.
ask.zh-Hans: 用背后跟拍拍摄在林中行走的人物背影，稍微落后一点跟着。

summary.en: The camera trails a weaving walker along the same path a few metres behind; the person stays near the centre, seen from the back.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机沿同一路径，在几米后方跟随曲线行走的人物；人物以背影视角保持在画面中央附近。

en: Path: the person walks the curve x = 1.8·sin(2.2s), depth z = 4 + 9s (s from 0 to 1), from 4 m to 13 m away
Camera: follows on the same curve at s-0.4 (about 3.6–3.9 m behind) and always faces the person, yaw = atan2(person x - camera x, person z - camera z); height 1.5 m
Timing: 0.3 s to 4.2 s (3.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)); legs and arms swing by sin(s×30)×0.42 rad
The person stays near the centre of frame, seen from behind; posts and a rock beside the path sweep past in the foreground (#029 Tracking shot runs alongside)
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows the distance to the person (FOLLOW 3.6–3.9m)
zh-Hans: 路径：人物沿曲线 x = 1.8·sin(2.2s)、纵深 z = 4 + 9s 行走，s 从 0→1，距离从 4→13 m。
相机：沿同一曲线的 s−0.4 位置跟随，约落后 3.6–3.9 m，始终朝向人物，偏航角 = atan2(person x - camera x, person z - camera z)；高度 1.5 m。
时间：0.3–4.2 s（3.9 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)；四肢按 sin(s×30)×0.42 rad 摆动。
人物背对镜头，保持在画面中央附近；路边柱子与岩石从前景掠过（#029 Tracking shot 在侧面并行跟拍）。
返回：最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点，一轮 4.7 s；右上角显示与人物的距离：FOLLOW 3.6–3.9m。

use.en: To enter a place together with a character, or for a third-person, game-like view.
use.zh-Hans: 用于与角色一同进入某个地方，或呈现类似游戏的第三人称视角。

meaning.en: Camera fixed; only the subject moves
meaning.zh-Hans: 相机固定不动，只有主体移动

ask.en: Locked-off shot of the crossing: camera fixed on a tripod, only the people and cars pass through.
ask.zh-Hans: 用固定镜头拍十字路口：相机固定在三脚架上，只有行人和车辆经过。

summary.en: A person crosses in front of a tripod-fixed camera and a car passes behind; the camera does not move by a pixel.
summary.zh-Hans: 人物从三脚架固定的相机前走过，汽车从后方驶过；相机连一个像素都不移动。

en: Camera: completely fixed (height 1.4 m, facing forward, focal length 330 px); only the subjects move
Subject: a person crosses left to right at constant speed 6.5 m ahead (x = -6.2 m → +6.2 m in 4.7 s); legs and arms swing by sin(u×7)×0.42 rad
A grey car crosses right to left 15 m away (x = +16 m → -16 m in 4.7 s)
Both start and end outside the frame, so it loops seamlessly every 4.7 s
A grey tripod mark at bottom left; top-right readout shows "LOCKED" (#040 Freeze frame stops the footage time; here time runs and only the camera is still)
zh-Hans: 相机：完全固定，高度 1.4 m，朝向正前方，焦距 330 px；只有主体移动。
主体：人物在前方 6.5 m 处以恒速从左向右穿过，4.7 s 内 x 从 −6.2→+6.2 m；四肢按 sin(u×7)×0.42 rad 摆动。
灰色汽车在 15 m 远处从右向左驶过，4.7 s 内 x 从 +16→−16 m。
人物和汽车的起点、终点均在画面外，因此每 4.7 s 无缝循环。
左下角有灰色三脚架标记，右上角显示 LOCKED（#040 Freeze frame 会停止视频时间，此处时间继续，只有相机静止）。

use.en: To make the subject stand out by contrast, for fixed-point observation, or as a base for time-lapse and compositing.
use.zh-Hans: 用于通过动静对比突出主体、定点观察，或作为延时摄影及合成的基础镜头。

meaning.en: Fly through an opening into the next space
meaning.zh-Hans: 穿过窗户或门进入下一个空间

ask.en: Fly-through from the window into the room and over to the table.
ask.zh-Hans: 用穿越镜头从窗户进入房间，一直推到桌子上方。

summary.en: The camera flies toward a wall with a window, passes through the opening and comes out into the place beyond.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机飞向带窗的墙壁，穿过窗口，进入墙后的空间。

en: Camera: moves forward 0 m → 12.5 m (height 1.3 m, direction fixed); a wall with a window stands 8 m ahead and the camera passes through it
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.6 s (3.1 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Wall: a pale grey plane 80 m wide and 14 m tall with a window 2.4 m wide and 2.2 m tall (sill at 0.15 m); through it a person (0.3 m right, 14.5 m away), trees, buildings and mountains are visible
Pass-through: the wall stops being drawn 0.25 m in front of the camera; by then the window edge is outside the frame (half-width about 1580 px), so it vanishes unseen
After the pass the place beyond fills the frame and the camera closes to 2 m from the person (#035 FPV drone shot keeps weaving between trees)
Return: hold 3.6–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the distance to the window ("Window: 8.0m" → "PASS", passed)
zh-Hans: 相机：向前移动 0→12.5 m，高度 1.3 m，方向固定；带窗墙壁位于前方 8 m，相机从窗口穿过。
时间：0.5–3.6 s（3.1 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
墙壁：浅灰色平面，宽 80 m、高 14 m；窗口宽 2.4 m、高 2.2 m，窗台高 0.15 m。透过窗口可见人物（右侧 0.3 m、远处 14.5 m）、树木、建筑与山。
穿越：墙面到相机前方 0.25 m 时停止绘制；此时窗边已在画面外，半宽约 1580 px，因此墙面无感消失。
穿过后，后方空间铺满画面，相机靠近至距人物 2 m（#035 FPV drone shot 会持续在树木间穿行）。
返回：3.6–4.2 s 保持，最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点；右上角显示距窗距离：距窗 8.0m（距窗 8.0 m）→经过（已穿过）。

use.en: To enter a building as an opening move, or to travel from one place to another in a single move.
use.zh-Hans: 用于以进入建筑作为开场，或用单一运动镜头从一个空间进入另一个。

meaning.en: Shoot from low down, looking up
meaning.zh-Hans: 从低处向上拍

ask.en: Shoot the hero's entrance from a low angle, looking up from near the ground.
ask.zh-Hans: 英雄登场用低角度镜头，从贴近地面处向上拍。

summary.en: The camera drops to near the ground and looks up; the person looks big and the buildings tower.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机降至贴近地面的位置向上仰拍，人物显得高大，建筑高耸入画。

en: Camera: lowers from 1.5 m to 0.35 m while the pitch goes 0 → +0.32 rad (about 18° up); no movement forward or back
Timing: 0.6 s to 2.2 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 4.5 m ahead; an 11.8 m tower stands 3 m left, 22 m away. As the camera looks up, person and tower stretch upward and the horizon drops
Hold: stays at the low angle from 2.2 s to 4.2 s (time to read the composition itself)
Return: cross-fade back to eye level over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows angle and height (↗ 0° · 1.5m → ↗ 18° · 0.4m)
zh-Hans: 相机：从 1.5 m 降至 0.35 m，同时俯仰角从 0→+0.32 rad（向上约 18°）；不前后移动。
时间：0.6–2.2 s（1.6 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
主体：人物静止站在前方 4.5 m；高 11.8 m 的塔楼位于左侧 3 m、远处 22 m。相机仰起时，人物和塔楼向上延展，地平线下降。
保持：2.2–4.2 s 停留在低角度，留出观看构图本身的时间。
返回：最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回平视，一轮 4.7 s；右上角显示角度和高度：↗ 0° · 1.5m→↗ 18° · 0.4m。

use.en: To make a person look powerful or large, or to emphasise the height of a building.
use.zh-Hans: 用于使人物显得强大、高大，或强调建筑的高度。

meaning.en: Shoot from above, looking down
meaning.zh-Hans: 从高处向下拍

ask.en: Use a high angle for the lost-child scene, looking down from above so they look small.
ask.zh-Hans: 迷路孩子的场景用高角度镜头，从稍高处向下拍，让孩子显得很小。

summary.en: The camera rises and looks down; the person looks small and the ground fills most of the frame.
summary.zh-Hans: 相机升高并向下俯拍，人物显得渺小，地面占据大部分画面。

en: Camera: rises from 1.5 m to 4.5 m while the pitch goes 0 → -0.5 rad (about 29° down); no movement forward or back
Timing: 0.6 s to 2.2 s (1.6 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Subject: a person stands still 5 m ahead; as the camera looks down they shrink and move lower, the ground grid fills most of the frame and the horizon leaves at the top
Hold: stays at the high angle from 2.2 s to 4.2 s (#031 Crane up keeps rising to 9 m; 13 Bird's-eye view looks straight down at 90°)
Return: cross-fade back to eye level over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows angle and height (↘ 0° · 1.5m → ↘ 29° · 4.5m)
zh-Hans: 相机：从 1.5 m 升至 4.5 m，同时俯仰角从 0→−0.5 rad（向下约 29°）；不前后移动。
时间：0.6–2.2 s（1.6 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
主体：人物静止站在前方 5 m；相机俯下时，人物缩小并向下移动，地面网格占据大部分画面，地平线从顶部离开。
保持：2.2–4.2 s 停留在高角度（#031 Crane up 会持续升至 9 m；13 Bird's-eye view 则以 90° 垂直向下看）。
返回：最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回平视，一轮 4.7 s；右上角显示角度和高度：↘ 0° · 1.5m→↘ 29° · 4.5m。

use.en: To make a person look vulnerable or small, or to explain a situation from above.
use.zh-Hans: 用于使人物显得脆弱、渺小，或从上方交代场景。

meaning.en: See through a character's eyes
meaning.zh-Hans: 以角色的视线观看

ask.en: The moment of opening the door and entering the room as a POV shot, through their eyes.
ask.zh-Hans: 开门走进房间的那一刻用 POV 镜头，以角色本人的视线拍摄。

summary.en: Seen through a character's eyes: the walking sway and the hands at the bottom say first person, and the person ahead waves at you.
summary.zh-Hans: 从角色眼中观看：步行晃动和底部双手表明第一人称视角，前方人物向你挥手。

en: Camera: walks forward 0 m → 3.2 m at the character's eye height of 1.6 m; 0.3 s to 4.2 s (3.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Walking sway: height ±3 cm (6 cycles per 4.7 s), roll ±0.008 rad (3 cycles), added only while moving
Hands: blue rounded hands at both bottom corners (±178 px from centre), a white phone in the right one; they move with the body, so the hands stay still and the world sways
The other person, 7.5 m ahead, raises both arms and waves only from 1.6 s to 3.4 s (looking at you); two posts in the foreground
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows "POV"
zh-Hans: 相机：以角色眼高 1.6 m 向前行走 0→3.2 m；0.3–4.2 s（3.9 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
步行晃动：高度 ±3 cm（每 4.7 s 六次），滚转 ±0.008 rad（三次），仅移动期间叠加。
双手：画面底部两角有蓝色圆角手形，距中心 ±178 px，右手拿白色手机；它们随身体移动，因此双手保持稳定，周围世界晃动。
另一人物位于前方 7.5 m，仅在 1.6–3.4 s 举起双臂向你挥手；前景有两根柱子。
返回：最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点，一轮 4.7 s；右上角显示 POV。

use.en: To put the viewer in the character's place, or for a game-like or VR-like feel.
use.zh-Hans: 让观众置身角色的位置，或营造游戏、VR 式体验。

meaning.en: Frame one person over another's shoulder
meaning.zh-Hans: 越过一人的肩膀拍另一人

ask.en: Shoot the conversation over the shoulder, with the foreground shoulder slightly out of focus.
ask.zh-Hans: 对话用过肩镜头拍摄，前景的肩膀稍微虚化。

summary.en: The back of one person's head and shoulder sit at the edge of frame and the other person is seen past them; the foreground is soft, the subject sharp.
summary.zh-Hans: 一人的后脑和肩膀位于画面边缘，越过其肩膀可见另一人；前景柔焦，主体清晰。

en: Framing: the back of the foreground person's head and shoulder (grey, 0.62 m left, 1.15 m away) fill the left edge; the other person (blue, 0.32 m right, 3.1 m away) is seen past the shoulder
Focus: the foreground shoulder is blurred 2.6 px, the other person is sharp and framed from the chest up
Camera: height 1.55 m, yaw +0.05 rad; pushes in slowly 0 m → 0.35 m from 0.5 s to 3.4 s (cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
The other person sways arms and legs by 0.35·sin(u×5) rad, as if talking
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows "OTS"
zh-Hans: 构图：前景人物灰色的后脑和肩膀位于左侧 0.62 m、距相机 1.15 m，占据左边缘；越过肩膀可见另一蓝色人物，位于右侧 0.32 m、距相机 3.1 m。
对焦：前景肩膀模糊 2.6 px，另一人物清晰，取胸部以上构图。
相机：高度 1.55 m，偏航角 +0.05 rad；0.5–3.4 s 缓慢前推 0→0.35 m，三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
另一人物四肢按 0.35·sin(u×5) rad 摆动，仿佛正在说话。
返回：3.4–4.2 s 保持，最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点；右上角显示 OTS。

use.en: To show who is facing whom in a conversation and to focus on the other person's expression.
use.zh-Hans: 用于交代对话中人物的相对朝向，并将注意力集中在对方表情上。

meaning.en: Straight down from directly overhead
meaning.zh-Hans: 从正上方垂直向下拍

ask.en: Bird's-eye view of the crossing from directly above, people and cars moving as seen from the top.
ask.zh-Hans: 从正上方用鸟瞰镜头拍十字路口，人和车以从上往下看的样子移动。

summary.en: Looking straight down from overhead: road, people, cars and trees appear as top-down shapes, and more comes into view as the camera rises.
summary.zh-Hans: 从正上方向下看，道路、人物、汽车与树木呈现俯视形状；相机升高时，更多区域进入视野。

en: Camera: points straight down (pitch -π/2 = -90°) and rises from 9 m to 15 m, directly above the origin
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Ground: a 2 m grid and a 3.2 m wide road (white dashed centre line) drawn as one plane; six trees as circles and three buildings as squares, seen from above
Subjects: a person (head circle and shoulder ellipse) walks 5.2 m up the right side of the road, a car (1.8×4 m) drives 6.8 m down the left side; both move in proportion to the progress p
As the camera rises everything shrinks and more of the ground comes into view (10 High angle looks down at a slant)
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows "↓ 90° · 9m → 15m"
zh-Hans: 相机：垂直向下（俯仰角 −π/2 = −90°），位于原点正上方，从 9 m 升至 15 m。
时间：0.5–3.4 s（2.9 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
地面：2 m 网格及 3.2 m 宽的道路（白色虚线中线）绘制于同一平面；俯视下，六棵树为圆形，三栋建筑为方形。
主体：人物由头部圆形和肩部椭圆组成，沿道路右侧向上走 5.2 m；汽车尺寸 1.8 × 4 m，沿道路左侧向下行驶 6.8 m；两者位移均与进度 p 成比例。
相机升高时，一切缩小，更多地面进入画面（10 High angle 为倾斜向下的俯拍）。
返回：3.4–4.2 s 保持，最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点；右上角显示 ↓ 90° · 9m→15m。

use.en: To show layout and paths like a diagram, or for a god's-eye overview.
use.zh-Hans: 用于像示意图一样展示布局和路径，或呈现上帝视角的全局概览。

meaning.en: Near and far all in sharp focus
meaning.zh-Hans: 从近处到远处全部清晰

ask.en: Deep focus, so the cup in front and the person behind are both sharp.
ask.zh-Hans: 前景的杯子和后方的人物都要清晰，所以用深焦镜头。

summary.en: From the flower in front to the person and buildings behind, everything comes into sharp focus at the same time.
summary.zh-Hans: 从前景花朵到后方人物和建筑，所有景物同时变得清晰。

en: Camera: position, direction and focal length all fixed (height 1.1 m); only the blur amounts change

Blur: the foreground flower (0.75 m left, 2 m away) goes 5 px → 0 px and the background (person 0.9 m right, 9 m away; buildings; mountains) goes 6 px → 0 px, both sharpening together (#033 Rack focus blurs one side)
Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Focus markers: blue corner brackets on both the flower (half-width 46 px) and the person (half-width 30 px), opacity 0 → 1 as focus arrives
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the aperture (f/1.8 → f/16)
zh-Hans: 相机：位置、方向和焦距均固定，高度 1.1 m；仅改变模糊程度。
模糊：前景花朵位于左侧 0.75 m、远处 2 m，模糊从 5→0 px；背景包括右侧 0.9 m、远处 9 m 的人物，以及建筑和山，模糊从 6→0 px；前后景同时变清晰（#033 Rack focus 会让其中一侧变模糊）。
时间：0.5–3.4 s（2.9 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
对焦标记：花朵和人物均有蓝色角括号，半宽分别为 46、30 px；随着对焦完成，不透明度从 0→1。
返回：3.4–4.2 s 保持，最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点；右上角显示光圈 f/1.8→f/16。

use.en: When the viewer may look anywhere in the frame, or to show several things happening at different depths at once.
use.zh-Hans: 用于允许观众自由观看画面各处，或同时展示不同纵深中发生的事情。

meaning.en: A wide opening shot that shows the place
meaning.zh-Hans: 开场交代地点的远景

ask.en: Open with an establishing shot of the whole town, with the location name on screen.
ask.zh-Hans: 开头先用能看到整个城镇的定场镜头，同时显示地名。

summary.en: A wide, high view of the whole town; the camera pushes in slowly and a location caption appears at bottom left.
summary.zh-Hans: 从高处以广角展示整个城镇，相机缓慢前推，左下角出现地点字幕。

en: Camera: wide lens (focal length 220 px, shown as 16mm), height 4.5 m, pitch -0.06 rad; pushes in slowly from -5 m to -2.5 m
Timing: 0.3 s to 4.2 s (3.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
Scene: eight city buildings 30 m away, a tower 16 m right and 36 m away, three clouds and mountains; a small person 1 m left, 12 m away gives the scale
Location caption: from 0.9 s to 1.3 s a white card reading "EXT. CITY – DAY" (158×30 px, blue bar on its left) fades in at bottom left while moving up 8 px, then stays
Return: cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s); top-right readout shows "16mm WIDE"
zh-Hans: 相机：广角镜头，焦距 220 px，显示为 16mm；高度 4.5 m，俯仰角 −0.06 rad；从 −5 m 缓慢前推至 −2.5 m。
时间：0.3–4.2 s（3.9 s），三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)。
场景：30 m 远处有八栋城市建筑，塔楼位于右侧 16 m、远处 36 m，另有三朵云和山；左侧 1 m、远处 12 m 的小人物提供尺度参照。
地点字幕：0.9–1.3 s，左下角的白色卡片上升 8 px 并淡入，写有 EXT. CITY – DAY，尺寸 158 × 30 px，左侧带蓝色竖条，之后保持显示。
返回：最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点，一轮 4.7 s；右上角显示 16mm WIDE。

use.en: At the start of a scene to say where we are, or whenever the place or time changes.
use.zh-Hans: 用于场景开头交代地点，或在地点、时间发生变化时使用。

meaning.en: Fill the frame with one small detail
meaning.zh-Hans: 只放大眼睛或指尖等局部

ask.en: Extreme close-up on just the eye at the moment the tear falls.
ask.zh-Hans: 眼泪落下的瞬间，用只拍眼睛的大特写。

summary.en: From a close-up of the face to a frame filled by nothing but the eyes.
summary.zh-Hans: 从面部特写逐渐拉近，直到画面只剩铺满视野的双眼。

en: Camera: the face's right eye (0.06 m left of centre, 1.66 m high) 1.3 m ahead is placed at the centre of frame; the camera does not move
Focal length: 610 px → 2040 px (shown as 44mm → 148mm, about 3.3×); f = 610 × (2040/610)^p, where p is a cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)) from 0.5 s to 3.4 s

Face: a blue head (radius 0.16 m) with white eyes (ellipses 0.045×0.028 m), dark pupils (radius 0.016 m), highlights and white brows; it starts as a close-up of the whole face (head about 150 px across) and ends with only the eyes filling the frame
Background: trees and buildings blurred 3 px, leaving the frame as the lens closes in
Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows the focal length and the abbreviation (44mm CU → 148mm ECU)
zh-Hans: 相机：将前方 1.3 m 处面部的右眼（中心左侧 0.06 m、高 1.66 m）置于画面中央；相机不移动。
面部：蓝色头部半径 0.16 m，白色眼睛为 0.045 × 0.028 m 椭圆，深色瞳孔半径 0.016 m，带高光和白色眉毛；起初为整张脸的特写，头部宽约 150 px，结束时只有双眼铺满画面。
背景：树木和建筑模糊 3 px，随着镜头拉近逐渐离开画面。
返回：3.4–4.2 s 保持，最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回起点；右上角显示焦距及景别缩写：44mm CU→148mm ECU。

use.en: For the emotional peak, or to make the viewer notice one small detail.
use.zh-Hans: 用于情绪高潮，或引导观众注意某个微小细节。

meaning.en: Cut in to a detail of the same scene
meaning.zh-Hans: 插入同一场景中的细节

ask.en: Insert shot of the hand turning the key, then straight back to the scene.
ask.zh-Hans: 转动钥匙时用插入镜头拍手部特写，然后马上切回。

summary.en: A big close-up of the watch on the person's wrist is cut into the scene for 1.3 s, then it returns to the same shot.
summary.zh-Hans: 场景中插入人物腕表的大特写，持续 1.3 s 后返回原镜头。

en: Join: two straight cuts (0 frames); to the detail at 1.6 s and back to the scene at 2.9 s (the detail lasts 1.3 s)
Main shot (A): fixed camera (height 1.4 m); a person stands 0.6 m left, 6 m away, with a watch (dark dot) on the wrist; a post 2.2 m right, 4 m away

Detail (INSERT): a big close-up of the wrist from the same scene; a blue sleeve (600×92 px, rotated -0.35 rad) on pale blue, a white dial (radius 58 px), dark hands and a blue second hand that makes one turn in 1.3 s
Bottom strip: three sections A (grey), detail (blue), A (grey) with a playhead; what is cut in belongs to the same scene (21 Cutaway shows a different subject)
Top-right readout shows "SHOT A" → "INSERT" → "SHOT A"; at 4.7 s it cuts straight back to the start
zh-Hans: 衔接：两次直接切换，过渡为 0 帧；1.6 s 切至细节，2.9 s 返回场景，细节持续 1.3 s。
主镜头 A：相机固定，高度 1.4 m；人物位于左侧 0.6 m、远处 6 m，腕部带有手表，以深色点表示；柱子位于右侧 2.2 m、远处 4 m。
细节 INSERT：同一场景中手腕的大特写；浅蓝底色上，蓝色袖子为 600 × 92 px，旋转 −0.35 rad；白色表盘半径 58 px，深色指针，蓝色秒针在 1.3 s 内转一圈。
底部条带：三段分别为 A（灰色）、细节（蓝色）、A（灰色），带播放头；插入内容属于同一场景（21 Cutaway 展示的是不同主体）。
右上角显示 SHOT A→INSERT→SHOT A；4.7 s 时直接切回起点。

use.en: To show a small object or a hand action, or to point out an important prop.
use.zh-Hans: 用于展示小物件、手部动作，或强调重要道具。

meaning.en: Blend two takes so the join disappears
meaning.zh-Hans: 平滑衔接相同构图的两段画面

ask.en: Remove the repeated sentence in the interview with a morph cut, so the join is invisible.
ask.zh-Hans: 用变形剪切去掉采访中说错重来的部分，让接缝看不出来。

summary.en: Two takes of the same person are joined by smoothly interpolating position and pose, so nothing jumps as in a jump cut.
summary.zh-Hans: 同一人物的两次拍摄通过位置和姿态的平滑插值衔接，避免跳切中的突变。

en: Take 1 (0–2.0 s): fixed camera (height 1.45 m); the person stands 0.4 m left, 3.3 m away, arms and legs at -0.45 rad. Take 2 (from 2.45 s): 0.35 m right, +0.55 rad. Both sway slightly by 0.12·sin(t×3) rad

Morph (2.0–2.45 s, 0.45 s): the position is interpolated with a quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1)), and the two poses are drawn at the same interpolated position and cross-faded
Only during the morph a blur of sin(q×π)×2.2 px is applied to the whole frame to soften the join (#041 Jump cut lets the position jump)
Bottom strip: take 1 (grey), morph (blue, narrow), take 2 (grey) with a playhead
Return: cross-fade back to the start of take 1 over the last 0.5 s; top-right readout shows "TAKE 1" → "MORPH" → "TAKE 2"
zh-Hans: 第 1 次拍摄（0–2.0 s）：相机固定，高度 1.45 m；人物位于左侧 0.4 m、远处 3.3 m，四肢角度 −0.45 rad。第 2 次拍摄（2.45 s 起）：人物位于右侧 0.35 m，四肢角度 +0.55 rad。两次均按 0.12·sin(t×3) rad 轻微摆动。
变形衔接：2.0–2.45 s，持续 0.45 s；位置采用二次缓入缓出插值，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1)，两种姿态绘制在同一插值位置并交叉淡化。
仅在变形期间，对整帧应用 sin(q×π)×2.2 px 的模糊，柔化衔接（#041 Jump cut 允许位置直接跳变）。
底部条带：第 1 次拍摄为灰色，变形为较窄的蓝色段，第 2 次拍摄为灰色，并带播放头。
返回：最后 0.5 s 交叉淡化回第 1 次拍摄起点；右上角显示 TAKE 1→MORPH→TAKE 2。

use.en: To tighten an interview or narration, or to remove a slip without drawing attention.
use.zh-Hans: 用于压缩采访或旁白间隙，或不引人注意地去掉口误。

meaning.en: The picture darkens to black
meaning.zh-Hans: 画面逐渐变暗直至全黑

ask.en: End the scene with a 1-second fade to black, then fade in from black.
ask.zh-Hans: 场景结尾用 1 s 淡出到黑场，下一场景再从黑场中淡入。

summary.en: The whole picture sinks to black, and the next scene brightens out of the black.
summary.zh-Hans: 整幅画面逐渐暗至黑场，下一场景再从黑暗中渐渐亮起。

en: Fade out: from 1.4 s to 2.6 s (1.2 s) black (rgb(20,20,24)) is laid over the outgoing picture with opacity 0 → 100%, quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1))
Black: fully black from 2.6 s to 3.1 s; at 2.9 s the incoming picture is swapped in unseen, with a straight cut
Fade in: from 3.1 s to 4.3 s (1.2 s) the black goes from 100% → 0 with the same easing
Camera: fixed in both pictures (A at height 1.4 m; B at height 1.6 m, pitch +0.1 rad); the subjects do not move either
Alternates A→B and B→A every 4.7 s (9.4 s for the round trip); top-right readout shows "FADE OUT" / "FADE IN"; the viewfinder marks stay over the black
zh-Hans: 淡出：1.4–2.6 s（1.2 s），在转出画面上叠加黑色 rgb(20,20,24)，不透明度 0→100%；二次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1)。
黑场：2.6–3.1 s 全黑；2.9 s 时通过直接切换，在不可见状态下换成下一幅画面。
淡入：3.1–4.3 s（1.2 s），黑色不透明度从 100%→0，使用相同缓动。
相机：两幅画面均固定，A 高度 1.4 m，B 高度 1.6 m、俯仰角 +0.1 rad；主体也保持不动。
每 4.7 s 交替执行 A→B、B→A，往返共 9.4 s；右上角显示 FADE OUT / FADE IN；取景器标记在黑场上仍保留。

use.en: For a chapter break, a long passage of time, or the end of a story.
use.zh-Hans: 用于章节分隔、较长时间流逝，或故事结尾。

meaning.en: A circle closes down to black
meaning.zh-Hans: 圆形窗口收拢，画面变黑

ask.en: Old-film style: iris out, closing on the hero to end the scene.
ask.zh-Hans: 以老电影的风格，用圈出收拢到主角身上，结束这个场景。

summary.en: A circle closes down on the person until the frame is black, then opens again on the next scene.
summary.zh-Hans: 圆形窗口以人物为中心收拢，直至画面全黑，再在下一场景中重新展开。

en: Iris out: from 1.3 s to 2.7 s (1.4 s) the circular window shrinks from radius 340 px to 0 (quadratic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1))); outside the circle is black (#141418)
Centre of the window: the current picture's subject, the person's head in A (0.6 m left, 1.63 m high, 7 m away) or the car in B (1.2 m right, 0.9 m high, 9 m away), projected to the screen
Black: 2.7–3.1 s; at 2.9 s the incoming picture is swapped in with a straight cut
Iris in: from 3.1 s to 4.4 s (1.3 s) the circle grows from 0 to 340 px around the incoming picture's subject
Edge: while the radius is at least 1 px, a 2 px blue circle marks the rim; the camera is fixed in both pictures
Alternates A→B and B→A every 4.7 s (9.4 s for the round trip); top-right readout shows "IRIS OUT" / "IRIS IN"
zh-Hans: 圈出 Iris out：1.3–2.7 s（1.4 s），圆形窗口半径从 340 px 缩至 0，二次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1)；圆外为黑色 #141418。
窗口中心：当前画面主体投影至屏幕的位置，A 为人物头部（左侧 0.6 m、高 1.63 m、远处 7 m），B 为汽车（右侧 1.2 m、高 0.9 m、远处 9 m）。
黑场：2.7–3.1 s；2.9 s 时直接切换为下一幅画面。
圈入 Iris in：3.1–4.4 s（1.3 s），以转入画面的主体为中心，圆半径从 0 增至 340 px。
边缘：半径至少为 1 px 时，以 2 px 蓝色圆线标记窗口边缘；两幅画面的相机均固定。
每 4.7 s 交替执行 A→B、B→A，往返共 9.4 s；右上角显示 IRIS OUT / IRIS IN。

use.en: For a silent-film or cartoon-style ending, or a playful break.
use.zh-Hans: 用于默片或卡通风格的结尾，或俏皮的段落分隔。

meaning.en: Cut to something else, then back
meaning.zh-Hans: 切到其他对象后再切回

ask.en: Cut away to the audience reaction in the middle of the talk, then back.
ask.zh-Hans: 讲话途中用切出镜头切到观众的反应，再切回来。

summary.en: From the speaker to the listening audience and back; what is cut in is a different subject.
summary.zh-Hans: 从讲话者切到聆听的观众，再切回来；插入的是不同主体。

en: Join: two straight cuts (0 frames); to the other subject at 1.7 s and back to the scene at 3.0 s (1.3 s away)
Main shot (A): fixed camera (height 1.4 m); a person 5.5 m away talks, swinging arms and legs by 0.45·sin(u×6) rad, with a grey lectern 0.9 m to the right
Other subject (CUTAWAY): the listening audience, five people 3.1–4.6 m away in blue and pale blue with both arms up, bouncing by |sin(t×9+i)|×5 cm; no background (a different place)
Bottom strip: A (grey), other subject (blue), A (grey) with a playhead (17 Insert shot shows a detail of the same scene)
Top-right readout shows "SHOT A" → "CUTAWAY" → "SHOT A"; at 4.7 s it cuts straight back to the start
zh-Hans: 衔接：两次直接切换，过渡为 0 帧；1.7 s 切至另一主体，3.0 s 返回原场景，切出持续 1.3 s。
主镜头 A：相机固定，高度 1.4 m；前方 5.5 m 的人物讲话，四肢按 0.45·sin(u×6) rad 摆动，右侧 0.9 m 有灰色讲台。
另一主体 CUTAWAY：聆听的观众，五人位于 3.1–4.6 m 远处，呈蓝色和浅蓝色，举起双臂，按 |sin(t×9+i)|×5 cm 上下弹动；没有背景，代表不同地点。
底部条带：A 为灰色、另一主体为蓝色、再回到灰色 A，并带播放头（17 Insert shot 展示同一场景的细节）。
右上角显示 SHOT A→CUTAWAY→SHOT A；4.7 s 时直接切回起点。

use.en: To show a reaction, or to hide a time skip or a removed slip.
use.zh-Hans: 用于展示反应，或掩盖时间省略和删去口误的位置。

meaning.en: Alternate between two simultaneous scenes
meaning.zh-Hans: 交替呈现同时发生的两个场景

ask.en: Cross-cut between the runner and the chasing car, with the cuts getting shorter.
ask.zh-Hans: 用交叉剪辑交替展示逃跑的人和追赶的车，镜头逐渐变短。

summary.en: Two scenes happening at the same time, a runner and a car, alternate in shorter and shorter cuts.
summary.zh-Hans: 同时发生的两个场景——跑步人物与汽车——交替出现，镜头越来越短。

en: Two scenes share one clock: A is a runner (0.3 m left, depth 15 m → 4.5 m, legs at u×12), B is a car in the city (1 m right, depth 17 m → 4.5 m); both close in over 4.7 s
Cuts: straight cuts between A and B at 0 / 1.1 / 2.0 / 2.7 / 3.3 / 3.8 / 4.2 / 4.5 s; the shots shorten 1.1 → 0.9 → 0.7 → 0.6 → 0.5 → 0.4 → 0.3 s to raise the tension
Each scene keeps running while the other is on screen (when it comes back, its subject has moved on)
Camera: A at height 1.3 m, fixed, with four posts in the foreground; B at height 1.6 m, pitch +0.06 rad, fixed, with the city and sun
Bottom strip: eight alternating sections A (grey) and B (blue) with a playhead; the last 0.3 s cross-fades back to the start of A
Top-right readout shows "SCENE A" / "SCENE B"
zh-Hans: 两个场景共用同一时钟：A 为跑步人物，位于左侧 0.3 m，纵深 15→4.5 m，腿部运动为 u×12；B 为城中汽车，位于右侧 1 m，纵深 17→4.5 m；两者均在 4.7 s 内靠近相机。
一个场景显示时，另一个场景仍继续推进，再次切回时主体已经前进。
相机：A 高度 1.3 m、固定，前景有四根柱子；B 高度 1.6 m、俯仰角 +0.06 rad、固定，画面中有城市和太阳。
底部条带：八段交替的 A（灰色）与 B（蓝色），带播放头；最后 0.3 s 交叉淡化回 A 的起始状态。
右上角显示 SCENE A / SCENE B。

use.en: To build tension between things happening at once, such as a chase or a rescue.
use.zh-Hans: 用于追逐、救援等同时发生的事件，增强紧张感。

meaning.en: Time stands still while the camera circles
meaning.zh-Hans: 时间静止，相机绕主体旋转

ask.en: Bullet time at the top of the jump: freeze the moment and circle the camera around.
ask.zh-Hans: 在跳跃最高点用子弹时间：让时间停住，只有相机绕着人物转。

summary.en: Time nearly stops at the top of a jump while the camera circles around the person.
summary.zh-Hans: 人物跳至最高点时，时间几乎停止，相机绕人物转动。

en: Footage time: runs normally for 0–1.5 s, at 0.1× from 1.5 s to 3.3 s (only 0.18 s of footage in 1.8 s), then normally again (footage time = u - 1.62)

Subject: a person 9 m away jumps on a parabola over footage time 0.6–2.6 s (peak 1.1 m, arms raised); during the slow part they seem to hang near the top (45–54% through); nine leaves fall on the same footage time

Camera: during the slow part it travels on a circle of radius 6 m around the person from -0.6 rad to +0.6 rad (about 69°), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)); always facing the centre, height 1.6 m, pitch -0.05 rad
The next 4.7 s pass circles the other way (+0.6 → -0.6 rad), so the 9.4 s loop is seamless (#030 Orbit does not stop time)
A dashed circle of radius 1.3 m on the ground and a ring of trees at 10 m; top-right readout shows "×1.0" → "BULLET ×0.1" → "×1.0"
zh-Hans: 视频时间：0–1.5 s 正常推进，1.5–3.3 s 为 0.1×（1.8 s 内仅推进 0.18 s 视频），之后恢复正常，视频时间 = u − 1.62。
主体：9 m 远处的人物在视频时间 0.6–2.6 s 内沿抛物线跳跃，最高 1.1 m，双臂举起；慢速阶段看似悬停在最高点附近，跳跃进度为 45%–54%；九片叶子也按同一视频时间下落。
相机：慢速阶段沿人物周围半径 6 m 的圆周，从 −0.6→+0.6 rad 转动，约 69°；三次缓入缓出，约等于 cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)；始终朝向中心，高度 1.6 m，俯仰角 −0.05 rad。
接下来 4.7 s 反向绕行，从 +0.6→−0.6 rad，因此整个 9.4 s 循环无缝衔接（#030 Orbit 不会停止时间）。
地面有半径 1.3 m 的虚线圆，周围 10 m 处环绕一圈树木；右上角显示 ×1.0→BULLET ×0.1→×1.0。

use.en: To show a decisive moment in three dimensions, or as the highlight of an action scene.
use.zh-Hans: 用于立体呈现决定性瞬间，或作为动作场景的高潮。

meaning.en: A run of short shots condensing time
meaning.zh-Hans: 用一连串短镜头压缩时间

ask.en: A one-month training montage: about seven short shots in a row.
ask.zh-Hans: 用蒙太奇表现一个月的练习，连续排列约 7 个短镜头。

summary.en: Seven short shots show thirty days of training; straight cuts, with the date jumping at top right.
summary.zh-Hans: 七个短镜头展现三十天的训练，通过直接剪切衔接，右上角日期不断跳跃。

en: Seven shots joined by straight cuts (0 frames): 0.75 / 0.7 / 0.65 / 0.65 / 0.65 / 0.6 / 0.7 s (4.7 s in all); the date at top right jumps DAY 1 → 3 → 7 → 12 → 20 → 28 → 30

Shots: 1 tracking a runner (legs at t×14), 2 a jump in the park, 3 sunrise (sun rising from 4 m to 12 m), 4 arms raised from a low angle, 5 walking in the city (focal length 420 px), 6 circling the person from -0.3 to +0.3 rad, 7 arms raised in front of a flag
Thirty days of training condensed into 4.7 s; camera position, height and focal length change with every shot (#041 Jump cut keeps the same framing)
Bottom strip: seven sections, only the current shot in blue; the last 0.3 s cross-fades back to the start of the first shot
zh-Hans: 镜头：1 跟拍跑步者，腿部运动为 t×14；2 公园跳跃；3 日出，太阳高度从 4→12 m；4 低角度拍摄双臂举起；5 城中行走，焦距 420 px；6 绕人物从 −0.3→+0.3 rad 转动；7 在旗帜前举起双臂。
将三十天训练压缩为 4.7 s，每个镜头的相机位置、高度与焦距均有变化（#041 Jump cut 保持相同构图）。
底部条带分为七段，仅当前镜头为蓝色；最后 0.3 s 交叉淡化回第一个镜头的起始状态。

use.en: To show a long period of change or effort in a short time.
use.zh-Hans: 用于在短时间内展现长期变化或努力。

meaning.en: A circular ripple expands from the click point
meaning.zh-Hans: 点击位置扩散圆形波纹

ask.en: Use ripple feedback for this interaction, preserving the reference timing.
ask.zh-Hans: 为这个交互添加涟漪反馈，保持参考中的时序和缓动。

summary.en: A circular ripple expands from the click point.
summary.zh-Hans: 点击位置扩散圆形波纹。

en: Canvas 539 × 208; 4.8-second loop; background #eff3e9, primary #597a36; bundled Motion Sans.
A 200 × 66 button at (170,72); ripple centre (235,105). From 0.6–1.5 s radius grows 0→180 and opacity falls 0.6→0, clipped inside the button.
Drawing depends only on time. Text follows Chinese/English language selection; reduced motion uses a static keyframe.
zh-Hans: 画布 539 × 208，4.8 秒循环；浅绿背景 #eff3e9，主色 #597a36；Motion Sans 内置字体。
所有绘制仅由时间参数决定；画面文字跟随中文/英文切换，系统减少动态时展示静止关键帧。

use.en: Interactive controls, state changes and immediate user feedback.
use.zh-Hans: 交互控件、状态切换与即时操作反馈。

meaning.en: The button moves gently toward the pointer
meaning.zh-Hans: 按钮向指针方向轻微偏移

ask.en: Use magnetic button for this interaction, preserving the reference timing.
ask.zh-Hans: 为这个交互添加磁吸按钮，保持参考中的时序和缓动。

summary.en: The button moves gently toward the pointer.
summary.zh-Hans: 按钮向指针方向轻微偏移。

en: Canvas 539 × 208; 4.8-second loop; background #eff3e9, primary #597a36; bundled Motion Sans.
The button moves gently toward the pointer. Positions follow sine and cosine over 4.8 seconds, matching at the loop boundary.
Drawing depends only on time. Text follows Chinese/English language selection; reduced motion uses a static keyframe.
zh-Hans: 画布 539 × 208，4.8 秒循环；浅绿背景 #eff3e9，主色 #597a36；Motion Sans 内置字体。
按钮向指针方向轻微偏移。位置使用 4.8 秒周期的正弦和余弦确定，首尾位置一致。
所有绘制仅由时间参数决定；画面文字跟随中文/英文切换，系统减少动态时展示静止关键帧。

use.en: Interactive controls, state changes and immediate user feedback.
use.zh-Hans: 交互控件、状态切换与即时操作反馈。

meaning.en: The button presses into its base
meaning.zh-Hans: 按钮压入底座并缩短阴影

ask.en: Use press depth for this interaction, preserving the reference timing.
ask.zh-Hans: 为这个交互添加按压纵深，保持参考中的时序和缓动。

summary.en: The button presses into its base.
summary.zh-Hans: 按钮压入底座并缩短阴影。

en: Canvas 539 × 208; 4.8-second loop; background #eff3e9, primary #597a36; bundled Motion Sans.
The button presses into its base. Cubic ease-out enters from 0.4–1.4 s and reverses from 3.5–4.4 s.
Drawing depends only on time. Text follows Chinese/English language selection; reduced motion uses a static keyframe.
zh-Hans: 画布 539 × 208，4.8 秒循环；浅绿背景 #eff3e9，主色 #597a36；Motion Sans 内置字体。
按钮压入底座并缩短阴影。0.4–1.4 秒三次缓出进入，3.5–4.4 秒三次缓出撤回。
所有绘制仅由时间参数决定；画面文字跟随中文/英文切换，系统减少动态时展示静止关键帧。

use.en: Interactive controls, state changes and immediate user feedback.
use.zh-Hans: 交互控件、状态切换与即时操作反馈。

meaning.en: A card slides left to reveal delete
meaning.zh-Hans: 卡片左移露出删除操作

ask.en: Use swipe to dismiss for this interaction, preserving the reference timing.

use.zh-Hans: 展示分批任务或步骤完成。

en: Twelve 29×34 px blocks use a 36 px horizontal step; completed blocks are blue with white checks.
Block i fills with cubic ease-out over 0.3 + 0.17i to 0.65 + 0.17i s; the bottom count reaches 12 over 0.35–2.85 s.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 十二格，每格 29×34 px，水平步长 36 px；完成格用蓝色与白色对勾。
第 i 格在 0.3 + 0.17i 至 0.65 + 0.17i 秒以三次方缓出填充；底部计数在 0.35–2.85 秒增至 12。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Prices update in stages while the label switches between buying pressure and a pullback.
meaning.zh-Hans: 价格分段跳动，趋势标签在上涨和回调之间变化。

summary.en: Prices update in stages while the label switches between buying pressure and a pullback.
summary.zh-Hans: 价格分段跳动，趋势标签在上涨和回调之间变化。

ask.en: Create a market ticker animation: Prices update in stages while the label switches between buying pressure and a pullback. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作行情跳动动效：价格分段跳动，趋势标签在上涨和回调之间变化。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Display quotes or market movement.
use.zh-Hans: 展示报价或交易行情。

en: Prices are 102.8, 108.4, 105.2, 114.6; stages advance every 1.1 s and interpolate with 0.45 s cubic ease-out.
The main number is 48 px; mint labels indicate rises, coral indicates falls; 16 small bars illuminate over time.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 四个价格为 102.8、108.4、105.2、114.6；每 1.1 秒进入下一阶段，阶段内以 0.45 秒三次方缓出更新。
主数字 48 px，涨为薄荷色标签、跌为珊瑚色标签；底部 16 根小柱随时间点亮。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Three colored stacked bars extend together.
meaning.zh-Hans: 三组彩色堆叠条同时延伸。

summary.en: Three colored stacked bars extend together.
summary.zh-Hans: 三组彩色堆叠条同时延伸。

ask.en: Create a stacked quota animation: Three colored stacked bars extend together. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作堆叠配额动效：三组彩色堆叠条同时延伸。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Compare resource allocations, budgets or quota composition.
use.zh-Hans: 比较资源分配、预算或配额组成。

en: Three tracks are 408 px wide and 28 px tall, spaced 45 px vertically; each contains three colored data segments.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 三条底轨均宽 408 px、高 28 px，纵向间隔 45 px；各条含三个不同颜色的数据段。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Liquid rises inside a circular vessel while its surface gently waves.
meaning.zh-Hans: 圆形容器中的液面升高，并持续轻微起伏。

summary.en: Liquid rises inside a circular vessel while its surface gently waves.
summary.zh-Hans: 圆形容器中的液面升高，并持续轻微起伏。

ask.en: Create a liquid level animation: Liquid rises inside a circular vessel while its surface gently waves. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作液位占比动效：圆形容器中的液面升高，并持续轻微起伏。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Show capacity, storage use or goal attainment.
use.zh-Hans: 表现容量、存储占比或目标达成。

en: Vessel center (270,120), radius 72 px; surface amplitude 5 px with wave sin(0.07x−4u).
Cubic ease-out over 0.35–2.85 s raises the surface from y = 192 to 58; the number increases 0%→93%.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 容器中心 (270,120)，半径 72 px；液面振幅 5 px，波形 sin(0.07x−4u)。
0.35–2.85 秒三次方缓出，液面从 y = 192 升至 58；数字从 0% 增至 93%。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Three differently weighted curves connect side nodes as dots travel along the flows.
meaning.zh-Hans: 三条宽度不同的曲线连接两侧节点，光点沿流向运动。

summary.en: Three differently weighted curves connect side nodes as dots travel along the flows.
summary.zh-Hans: 三条宽度不同的曲线连接两侧节点，光点沿流向运动。

ask.en: Create a sankey flow animation: Three differently weighted curves connect side nodes as dots travel along the flows. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作桑基流动动效：三条宽度不同的曲线连接两侧节点，光点沿流向运动。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Show quantities flowing from sources to destinations.
use.zh-Hans: 表达来源到目的地的数量流向。

en: Three cubic Bézier links have widths 17, 23, 21 px multiplied by progress; side nodes are 22×31 px.
Links thicken with cubic ease-out over 0.35–2.85 s; each carries six radius-3 px dots looping every 2 s.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 三条三次贝塞尔连线，宽度分别为 17、23、21 px 乘以进度；两侧节点宽 22 px、高 31 px。
连线在 0.35–2.85 秒以三次方缓出加粗；每条线上六个半径 3 px 的点，以 2 秒周期循环流动。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Four funnel tiers reveal in sequence, showing decreasing conversion shares.
meaning.zh-Hans: 四层漏斗逐层显露，展示逐步减少的转化比例。

summary.en: Four funnel tiers reveal in sequence, showing decreasing conversion shares.
summary.zh-Hans: 四层漏斗逐层显露，展示逐步减少的转化比例。

ask.en: Create a conversion funnel animation: Four funnel tiers reveal in sequence, showing decreasing conversion shares. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作漏斗转化动效：四层漏斗逐层显露，展示逐步减少的转化比例。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Explain conversion drop-off or business stages.
use.zh-Hans: 说明转化漏损或业务阶段。

en: Tier top widths are 420, 330, 240, 150 px; each is 28 px high with 35 px vertical steps; bottom edges are 60 px narrower.
Tier i reveals over 0.3 + 0.25i to 1.1 + 0.25i s; after 70% progress it shows labels 100%, 76%, 52%, 29%.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 四层顶部宽度为 420、330、240、150 px，各层高 28 px、纵向步长 35 px；底边比顶边窄 60 px。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Four bars grow and exchange ranked positions.
meaning.zh-Hans: 四条数据条增长并交换排名位置。

summary.en: Four bars grow and exchange ranked positions.
summary.zh-Hans: 四条数据条增长并交换排名位置。

ask.en: Create a ranking race animation: Four bars grow and exchange ranked positions. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作动态排名动效：四条数据条增长并交换排名位置。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Compare ranking changes or race results.
use.zh-Hans: 比较排名变化或竞赛结果。

en: Four items keep fixed colors; initial rows [0,1,2,3] move to [2,0,3,1] with 34 px row spacing.
Cubic ease-out over 0.7–3.2 s changes widths from 350×.35 to 350×[.82,.68,.95,.74] px; labels update in sync.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 四项颜色固定，初始行号 [0,1,2,3]，目标行号 [2,0,3,1]，行距 34 px。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Four rectangles expand from their own centers into a tiled area layout.
meaning.zh-Hans: 四块矩形从各自中心展开，形成嵌套面积布局。

summary.en: Four rectangles expand from their own centers into a tiled area layout.
summary.zh-Hans: 四块矩形从各自中心展开，形成嵌套面积布局。

ask.en: Create a treemap expansion animation: Four rectangles expand from their own centers into a tiled area layout. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作树图展开动效：四块矩形从各自中心展开，形成嵌套面积布局。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Compare shares or grouped structure by area.
use.zh-Hans: 用面积比较份额或分组结构。

en: Four target rectangles measure 240×132, 183×62, 88×64, 89×64 px with 6 px gaps.
Cubic ease-out expands blocks over 0.35–2.85 s; labels 48%, 28%, 12%, 12% appear after 75% progress.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Matrix cells activate along a diagonal wave, then pulse in color.
meaning.zh-Hans: 矩阵单元沿对角方向被激活，随后颜色脉动。

summary.en: Matrix cells activate along a diagonal wave, then pulse in color.
summary.zh-Hans: 矩阵单元沿对角方向被激活，随后颜色脉动。

ask.en: Create a matrix propagation animation: Matrix cells activate along a diagonal wave, then pulse in color. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作矩阵传播动效：矩阵单元沿对角方向被激活，随后颜色脉动。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Show batch state, computation propagation or processing coverage.
use.zh-Hans: 表达批量状态、计算传播或处理覆盖。

en: The 5×11 matrix uses 25×19 px cells with 36 px horizontal and 28 px vertical steps.
Cell (r,c) activates over 0.2 + .13(r+c) to 0.6 + .13(r+c) s; color then pulses with sin(4u−r−c).
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 矩阵为 5 行 11 列，每格 25×19 px，横向步长 36 px、纵向步长 28 px。
单元 (r,c) 在 0.2 + .13(r+c) 至 0.6 + .13(r+c) 秒激活；之后颜色按 sin(4u−r−c) 脉动。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Packets continuously move right through three transfer channels.
meaning.zh-Hans: 三条传输通道中的数据包持续向右流动。

summary.en: Packets continuously move right through three transfer channels.
summary.zh-Hans: 三条传输通道中的数据包持续向右流动。

ask.en: Create a packet transfer animation: Packets continuously move right through three transfer channels. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作数据包传输动效：三条传输通道中的数据包持续向右流动。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Explain API, database or inter-service transfer.
use.zh-Hans: 说明 API、数据库或服务间传输。

en: Three lanes are spaced 47 px vertically; each carries four 18×12 px packets between 53×32 px nodes.
Packets move uniformly along 300 px paths with a 2.4 s period; lane phases differ by 0.15.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 三条通道纵向相隔 47 px，每条有四个 18×12 px 数据包；两端节点为 53×32 px。
数据包在长 300 px 的路径上以 2.4 秒周期匀速运动，每条通道相位错开 0.15。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: Links draw between six nodes as data dots propagate along them.
meaning.zh-Hans: 六个节点之间的连线逐条绘出，数据光点沿线传播。

summary.en: Links draw between six nodes as data dots propagate along them.
summary.zh-Hans: 六个节点之间的连线逐条绘出，数据光点沿线传播。

ask.en: Create a network connections animation: Links draw between six nodes as data dots propagate along them. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作节点连接动效：六个节点之间的连线逐条绘出，数据光点沿线传播。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Explain dependencies, network topology or task flow.
use.zh-Hans: 解释依赖关系、网络拓扑或任务流。

en: Six nodes and seven blue links; link i extends with cubic ease-out over 0.25 + .18i to 1 + .18i s.
Coral radius-4 px dots traverse links every 2 s; white node radii pulse as 14 + 2sin(3u−i).
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 六个节点、七条蓝色连线；第 i 条在 0.25 + .18i 至 1 + .18i 秒以三次方缓出延伸。
珊瑚色光点半径 4 px，沿线以 2 秒周期流动；节点白色内圆半径按 14 + 2sin(3u−i) 脉动。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: A two-frequency waveform streams horizontally while its live readout changes.
meaning.zh-Hans: 双频波形持续横向流动，实时读数同步变化。

summary.en: A two-frequency waveform streams horizontally while its live readout changes.
summary.zh-Hans: 双频波形持续横向流动，实时读数同步变化。

ask.en: Create a live data stream animation: A two-frequency waveform streams horizontally while its live readout changes. Use a 4.8 s loop with a fade at each end.
ask.zh-Hans: 请制作实时数据流动效：双频波形持续横向流动，实时读数同步变化。使用 4.8 秒循环，并在首尾淡入淡出。

use.en: Demonstrate live monitoring, sensors or event streams.
use.zh-Hans: 演示实时监控、传感器或事件流。

en: 81 samples use a 5.6 px horizontal step; y = 122 + 30sin(a) + 15sin(2a), a = i/12 + 2u.
The coral endpoint has radius 6 px; the live readout is round(120 + 30sin(2u)), updating throughout the cycle.
Canvas 539×208, cycle 4.8 s; all content fades in over 0–0.2 s and out over 4.5–4.8 s, leaving the same background at both ends.
zh-Hans: 81 个采样点，横向步长 5.6 px；y = 122 + 30sin(a) + 15sin(2a)，a = i/12 + 2u。
末端珊瑚色点半径 6 px；实时读数为 round(120 + 30sin(2u))，整个周期持续更新。
画布 539×208，周期 4.8 秒；全部内容在 0–0.2 秒淡入、4.5–4.8 秒淡出，首尾为同一背景。

meaning.en: A blue stroke follows a sine path and retracts with an orange endpoint.
meaning.zh-Hans: 蓝色线条沿正弦路径绘制并回收，橙点标记端点。

ask.en: Create a looping path drawing effect. Draw a 410 px sine path from (65,104), amplitude 65 px, using 121 samples. Reveal 0→100%→0 with q=(1−cos(2πt/4.8))/2; stroke 7 px, endpoint radius 8 px.
ask.zh-Hans: 制作循环的路径描边效果。以 121 个采样点绘制从 (65,104) 出发、宽 410 px、振幅 65 px 的正弦路径。按 q=(1−cos(2πt/4.8))/2 揭示 0→100%→0；线宽 7 px，端点半径 8 px。

summary.en: A blue stroke follows a sine path and retracts with an orange endpoint.
summary.zh-Hans: 蓝色线条沿正弦路径绘制并回收，橙点标记端点。

use.zh-Hans: 将路径描边用于有表现力的矢量插画、专题标题或品牌叙事。

Draw a 410 px sine path from (65,104), amplitude 65 px, using 121 samples.
Reveal 0→100%→0 with q=(1−cos(2πt/4.8))/2; stroke 7 px, endpoint radius 8 px.
zh-Hans: 539×208 px Canvas 2D 卡片，4.8 s 确定性无缝循环。除特别说明外 q=(1−cos(2πt/4.8))/2。
以 121 个采样点绘制从 (65,104) 出发、宽 410 px、振幅 65 px 的正弦路径。
按 q=(1−cos(2πt/4.8))/2 揭示 0→100%→0；线宽 7 px，端点半径 8 px。

meaning.zh-Hans: 蓝色虚线沿固定折线路线流动。

ask.zh-Hans: 制作循环的虚线流动效果。五个顶点覆盖 x 65–475、y 55–150；线宽 7 px。虚线长/间隔为 14/12 px，每轮偏移 −208 px，恰好八个虚线周期。

summary.en: Blue dashes travel along a fixed zigzag route.

meaning.zh-Hans: 五个圆点沿椭圆运行，橙色圆点领头。

ask.zh-Hans: 制作循环的轨道圆点效果。轨道中心 (269,104)，半径 170×61 px，轨道线宽 3 px。五个半径 9 px 的圆点等距分布，每个在 4.8 s 内转一圈。

summary.en: Five dots orbit an ellipse, with one orange leader.
summary.zh-Hans: 五个圆点沿椭圆运行，橙色圆点领头。

Five radius-9 px dots are equally spaced; each completes one turn in 4.8 s.
zh-Hans: 539×208 px Canvas 2D 卡片，4.8 s 确定性无缝循环。除特别说明外 q=(1−cos(2πt/4.8))/2。
轨道中心 (269,104)，半径 170×61 px，轨道线宽 3 px。
五个半径 9 px 的圆点等距分布，每个在 4.8 s 内转一圈。

en: 539×208 px Canvas 2D card; 4.8 s deterministic seamless loop. Unless stated otherwise q=(1−cos(2πt/4.8))/2.
Place glyphs evenly around radius 76 px at (269,104), using 19 px type.
Rotate glyph positions one turn per cycle; rotate each glyph by its angle plus π/2.

字符位置每轮转一圈，每个字符旋转角为所在角度加 π/2。

ask.zh-Hans: 制作循环的文字扫描效果。使用位于 (269,104) 的 49 px 粗体标题；矩形遮罩起点 (60,49)，高 110 px。遮罩宽 419q px；4 px 橙色扫描线位于遮罩边缘，覆盖 y=53–155。
